79e74887d5e8a9bf0e0eea0a.title_original: Quadratic APN Functions of $\mathbb{F}_2^{10}$ with a Self-Equivalence of Prime Order
79e74887d5e8a9bf0e0eea0a.excerpt: arXiv:2611.18358v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Almost perfect nonlinear (APN) functions of $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ have the lowest possible differential uniformity. The only known APN permutation in even dimension, in dimension six, is equivalent to a quadratic APN function with a nontrivial linear self-equivalence; no APN permutation is known for even $n \geq 8$. In a published collection of about 3.8 million quadratic APN classes of dimension eight, at most 0.34% have a nontrivial linear self-equivalence. In dimension ten, the 25 literature classes considered here all have one. We study all quadratic APN functions of $\mathbb{F}_2^{10}$ with such a self-equivalence, which usually confines them to a much smaller linear space. Up to conjugacy and power similarity, self-equivalences of prime order have 299 types. We settle 298 of them. Elementary lemmas exclude 280 types, and exhaustive searches confirm this for 242 of them. The other 18 types are settled by exhaustive searches with exact equivalence certificates. Up to extended affine equivalence, the 298 types contain 29 classes of quadratic APN functions, four of them new. This also classifies the quadratic APN functions with coefficients in a subfield. Exactly 24 classes contain one with coefficients in $\mathbb{F}_4$, and all 3 that contain one with coefficients in $\mathbb{F}_{32}$ are among them. The open type consists of the quadratic canonical triplicate functions. They correspond to maximum additive Hermitian rank-distan

474dce9f21cf4ec72a2fef40.title_original: Adaptable Watermarking: Transforming Image Watermarking Models via Lightweight Adapters
474dce9f21cf4ec72a2fef40.excerpt: arXiv:2611.18363v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We explore the adaptability of neural image watermarking models; the extent to which one watermarking method can be transformed into another through lightweight adaptation. We introduce a framework that enables encoder-decoder watermarking architectures to become modular and upgradable, supporting multiple watermarking styles without re-training full models. Adaptation is performed by attaching a compact parameter-efficient adapter and fine-tuning under a multi-domain residual alignment loss (spatial, gradient, and frequency) while preserving bit accuracy via a secret-loss term. We evaluate this approach across a suite of recent watermarking models, including TrustMark, InvisMark, RoSteALS, HiDDeN, and WAM, demonstrating that adapted encoders closely reproduce target residuals and that adapted decoders recover messages with near-optimal accuracy under standard augmentations and distortions. We show that cross-model adaptation, with applications in interoperable and upgradable watermarking, can be achieved with as few as 1-2M trainable parameters per component (e.g., the 2M decoder adapter used in our multi-decoder inference pipeline).

f89fd57293ee47c37e98b42f.title_original: Pairing AIS with RF: Analysis of a Markovian Approach for Maritime Data Fusion
f89fd57293ee47c37e98b42f.excerpt: arXiv:2611.18563v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Monitoring maritime activities is important for safety and security, particularly for detecting illegal activities, but remains challenging due to the size and complexity of the maritime domain. The Automatic Identification System (AIS) is commonly used for this purpose, despite its known vulnerabilities. In contrast, space-based radio frequency (RF) observations provide an independent source of vessel activity but lack ship identification and therefore cannot identify vessels on their own. Following the CRISP-DM process, this study applies a Pair Hidden Markov Model (PHMM) to align individual RF detections with AIS trajectories, using temporal and spatial information while modeling noise and timing discrepancies. We evaluate it on NOAA AIS data with synthetic RF detections against nearest-neighbor baselines and analyze its errors with bias tests on trajectory length, sampling density, stationarity and AIS--RF distance. The length-corrected Forward score reaches a top-1 precision of $0.7776$ on the validation split of multi-candidate detections, where errors are possible, and an AUC of $0.637$ for detecting dark vessels among the detections that pass the prefilter. With a single RF detection, the score mostly reflects the AIS trajectory itself, and its errors favor longer and more stationary trajectories. A log-odds score, which compares the full model with a null model without match transitions, raises precision to $0.8580$ a

927bc821849270179eb3f4f1.title_original: Cyber-Zero: Training Cybersecurity Agents without Runtime
927bc821849270179eb3f4f1.excerpt: arXiv:2508.00910v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success in software engineering tasks when trained with executable runtime environments, particularly in resolving GitHub issues. However, such runtime environments are often unavailable in other domains, especially cybersecurity, where challenge configurations and execution contexts are ephemeral or restricted. We present Cyber-Zero, the first runtime-free framework for synthesizing high-quality agent trajectories to train cybersecurity LLMs. Cyber-Zero leverages publicly available CTF writeups and employs persona-driven LLM simulation to reverse-engineer runtime behaviors and generate realistic, long-horizon interaction sequences without actual environments. Using trajectories synthesized by Cyber-Zero, we train LLM-based agents that achieve up to 11.4% absolute performance gains over baseline models on three prominent CTF benchmarks: InterCode-CTF, NYU CTF Bench, and Cybench. Our best model, Cyber-Zero-32B, establishes new state-of-the-art performance among open-weight models, matching the capabilities of proprietary systems like DeepSeek-V3-0324 and Claude-3.5-Sonnet while offering superior cost-effectiveness, and demonstrating that runtime-free trajectory synthesis can effectively democratize the development of state-of-the-art cybersecurity agents.

fe0ea901bce129f6fe19e89b.title_original: HackWorld: Evaluating Computer-Use Agents on Exploiting Web Application Vulnerabilities
fe0ea901bce129f6fe19e89b.excerpt: arXiv:2510.12200v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Web applications are prime targets for cyberattacks as gateways to critical services and sensitive data. Traditional penetration testing is costly and expertise-intensive, making it difficult to scale with the growing web ecosystem. While language model agents show promise in cybersecurity, modern web applications demand visual understanding, dynamic content handling, and multi-step interactions that only computer-use agents (CUAs) can perform. Yet, their ability to discover and exploit vulnerabilities through graphical interfaces remains largely unexplored. We present HackWorld, the first framework for systematically evaluating CUAs' capabilities to exploit web application vulnerabilities via visual interaction. Unlike sanitized benchmarks, HackWorld includes 36 real-world applications across 11 frameworks and 7 languages, featuring realistic flaws such as injection vulnerabilities, authentication bypasses, and unsafe input handling. Using a Capture-the-Flag (CTF) setup, it tests CUAs' capacity to identify and exploit these weaknesses while navigating complex web interfaces. Evaluation of state-of-the-art CUAs reveals concerning trends: exploitation rates below 12% and low cybersecurity awareness. CUAs often fail at multi-step attack planning and misuse security tools. These results expose the current limitations of CUAs in web security contexts and highlight opportunities for developing more security-aware agents capable o

521b5a147e068495b0736b8f.title_original: From TS-SUF-2 to TS-SUF-4: Practical Security Enhancements for FROST2 Threshold Signatures
521b5a147e068495b0736b8f.excerpt: arXiv:2610.02805v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Threshold signature schemes play a vital role in securing digital assets within blockchain and distributed systems. FROST2 stands out as a practical threshold Schnorr signature scheme, noted for its efficiency and compatibility with standard verification processes. However, under the one-more discrete logarithm assumption, with static corruption and centralized key generation settings, FROST2 has been shown by Bellare et al. (in CRYPTO 2022) to achieve only TS-SUF-2 security, which is a consequence of its vulnerability to TS-UF-3 attacks. In this paper, we address this security limitation by presenting an enhanced variant of FROST2, namely, FROST2+ which achieves the TS-SUF-4 security level under the same computational assumptions as the original FROST2. FROST2+ strengthens FROST2 by integrating additional pre-processing token verifications that help mitigate TS-UF-3 and TS-UF-4 vulnerabilities while maintaining practical efficiency. We show that FROST2+ can achieve TS-SUF-4 security not only under the same conditions as the original FROST2 analysis, but also when initialized with a distributed key generation protocol such as PedPoP. Our benchmark using ZCash's FROST library shows that the performance of FROST2+ is comparable to FROST2 and about 64-79% faster than FROST when precomputation is enabled.

753f0036f84cbaa1893cd054.title_original: They Will See Johnny's Message: A Measurement Study of Post-Quantum Cryptography Across Email Delivery Paths
753f0036f84cbaa1893cd054.excerpt: arXiv:2610.36145v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Harvest-now, decrypt-later (HNDL) attacks make the transition to post-quantum cryptography (PQC) urgent for email. This paper presents a systematic measurement that jointly examines PQC deployment across email service stages, negotiation by communicating peers, and usable message encryption. Endpoint-level support alone does not establish PQC readiness across email workflows because submission, relay, and access use independently negotiated Transport Layer Security (TLS) connections. We therefore combine three snapshots of relay, submission, access, and webmail services associated with the Tranco Top~1M domains with controlled tests of mail clients, sending servers, and OpenPGP and S/MIME implementations. Our measurements reveal a transition concentrated among a few providers, with available capability not consistently translating into actual use. Fewer than half of the domains in each service panel support PQC, and Google alone accounts for approximately 87\% of hybrid-capable relay domains. Only two of eight tested sending providers negotiate PQC with our receiver, although five accept it inbound. When TLS groups are restricted to PQC, four of the six incompatible senders fall back to plaintext where unencrypted SMTP remains permitted. At the message layer, limited native key generation, key-format incompatibilities, and backend integration failures further constrain usable PQC encryption.

70d1d81bc2382ad99f741b8f.title_original: VerfGraph: Efficient Zero-Knowledge Verifiable Graph Query Evaluation System
70d1d81bc2382ad99f741b8f.excerpt: arXiv:2611.04240v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Graph databases are widely used to manage relationship-rich data and support multi-hop traversal and shortest-path queries in applications such as financial risk control and social networks. When a client issues such queries to a database owner, the returned result may be incorrect. However, the client cannot directly verify it because the graph is typically large and private, making re-executing the query both infeasible and insecure. Verifiable and confidential graph query evaluation thus plays an important role in such applications. We present VerfGraph, a zero-knowledge verifiable graph query evaluation system, which enables a client to verify that the query result was correctly computed over a committed graph, without revealing anything beyond the public inputs and what is implied by the query result. While adopting the expansion-centric operator model introduced by ZKGraph (ICDE'26), VerfGraph improves both proving efficiency and query expressiveness in two key ways. First, we propose new proof methods for the core operators in ZKGraph, such as graph expansion and shortest path, that require substantially fewer expensive comparisons and eliminate edge canonicalization for bidirectional edge relations. Second, we introduce dedicated proofs for count and weighted shortest-path operators, which ZKGraph does not support, broadening the class of graph queries that can be verified. We evaluate VerfGraph using the LDBC Social

c2f1a109e1fa8fd43a6299bf.title_original: Training Language Model Agents to Find Vulnerabilities with CTF-Dojo
c2f1a109e1fa8fd43a6299bf.excerpt: arXiv:2508.18370v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated exceptional capabilities when trained within executable runtime environments, notably excelling at software engineering tasks through verified feedback loops. Yet, scalable and generalizable execution-grounded environments remain scarce, limiting progress in training more capable ML agents. We introduce CTF-Dojo, the first large-scale executable runtime tailored for training LLMs with verifiable feedback, featuring 658 fully functional Capture-The-Flag (CTF)-style challenges containerized in Docker with guaranteed reproducibility. To enable rapid scaling without manual intervention, we develop CTF-Forge, an automated pipeline that transforms publicly available artifacts into ready-to-use execution environments in minutes, eliminating weeks of expert configuration traditionally required. We trained LLM-based agents on just 486 high-quality, execution-verified trajectories from CTF-Dojo, achieving up to 9.9% absolute gains over strong baselines across three competitive benchmarks: InterCode-CTF, NYU CTF Bench, and Cybench. Our best-performing 32B model reaches 31.9% Pass@1, establishing a new open-weight state-of-the-art that rivals frontier models like DeepSeek-V3-0324 and Gemini-2.5-Flash. a123afde9b09aeb4b3c00aa6.title_original: Adversarial Attacks on Downstream Weather Forecasting Models: Application to Tropical Cyclone Trajectory Prediction
a123afde9b09aeb4b3c00aa6.excerpt: arXiv:2510.10140v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Deep learning-based weather forecasting (DLWF) models leverage past weather observations to generate future forecasts, supporting a wide range of downstream applications, including tropical cyclone (TC) prediction. In this paper, we investigate the vulnerability of these models to adversarial attacks, where subtle perturbations to upstream forecasts can alter downstream TC trajectory predictions. Crafting perturbed inputs to steer downstream outputs toward attacker-specified trajectories is a challenging problem for several reasons. First, conventional TC detection systems are opaque, non-differentiable black boxes, making standard gradient-based attacks infeasible. Second, the extreme rarity of TC events leads to a severe class imbalance problem, making it difficult to develop attack methods that produce realistic-looking cyclone paths aligned with target trajectories. To overcome these limitations, we propose Cyc-Attack, a novel method for perturbing the forecasts of DLWF models to generate adversarial trajectories. The proposed method uses a differentiable surrogate model to approximate the TC detector's output, enabling the application of gradient-based attacks. Cyc-Attack also employs a skewness-aware loss function with a kernel dilation strategy to address the severe class imbalance problem. Distance-based gradient weighting and regularization strategies are also introduced to constrain perturbations to eliminate

371e6942f927f423c6579f5d.title_original: Denoising the US Census: Succinct Block Hierarchical Regression
371e6942f927f423c6579f5d.excerpt: arXiv:2603.10099v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The 2020 United States Census adopted differential privacy to protect individual confidentiality, adding calibrated noise to summary demographic measurements that are then reconciled into population tables. We developed BlueDown, a postprocessing algorithm that combines techniques from linear regression and constrained optimization while exploiting measurement structure for efficiency. On 2020 Census data, BlueDown reduced the error of groupings by race at the county level by 21-36% and of all county-level groupings by 9-58%; at the tract level, it reduced error of groupings by housing type by 38-61%. These gains came at no cost to confidentiality or computational efficiency, and would improve the validity of research relying on this definitive dataset and analyses used to guide the distribution of over $1.5 trillion in annual federal spending.

aaba9e6b332c2478eefd28de.title_original: ECGGuard: Deep Watermarking of Electrocardiogram Signals With Error-Correcting
aaba9e6b332c2478eefd28de.excerpt: arXiv:2610.13357v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Wearable electrocardiogram (ECG) recordings pass through multiple networks and systems before automated interpretation, leaving patient metadata vulnerable to loss. Digital watermarking can embed this metadata in the signal, but conventional methods fail under time shifts, and high waveform similarity does not guarantee the same downstream diagnosis. We present \rev{ECGGuard}, a deep watermarking framework for single-lead ECG. A fully convolutional generator embeds the payload without signal quantization, a detector decodes the message frame by frame and checks for watermark presence, and during training a frozen arrhythmia classifier penalizes changes that would alter its predictions. Because high bit accuracy does not ensure whole-message recovery, the payload is protected by extended Hamming codes, \rev{a validation-selected channel ordering}, and soft-decision decoding. On the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database, \rev{averaged over three training runs, ECGGuard} keeps bit accuracy above \rev{98\%} under time shifts of 10 to 50 samples, where transform-domain baselines drop to chance. The coded 16-bit payload is recovered exactly in \rev{99.95\%} of clean segments\rev{, in over 96\%} under time shifts, 10\% sample deletion, or 10\% packet loss\rev{, and in 99.1\% for unseen subjects}. \rev{For the guiding classifier, the diagnostic loss limits the drop in ventricular-beat sensitivity to 1.6 percentage points on the test rec

07822f31859abc92c2308112.title_original: SoK: Assessing Post-Quantum Cryptography Adoption in Software Development: Standards, Lifecycle Coverage, Deployment Maturity, and Evidence of Readiness
07822f31859abc92c2308112.excerpt: arXiv:2611.08442v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Standardised post-quantum cryptography (PQC) is critical for protecting software systems against future quantum threats, but standardised algorithms alone do not provide a pathway for their secure integration into software. This paper presents a Systematisation of Knowledge (SoK) of PQC integration in software development, synthesising existing approaches across implementation, migration, and developer education. We analyse these approaches against NIST PQC standards and PQC migration guidance, software development lifecycle coverage, cybersecurity practices, deployment maturity, and testing and evaluation evidence. Our analysis shows that existing work establishes important technical and organisational foundations but provides disconnected support across the software development lifecycle, with limited coordination between preparation, implementation, migration, deployment, maintenance, and developer practices. Evaluation evidence also remains concentrated in controlled or early-stage settings, providing stronger evidence of technical feasibility than operational readiness. We identify cross-cutting gaps and research directions for developing lifecycle-oriented, empirically validated approaches that connect technical, developer, and organisational requirements for secure PQC integration.

CVE-2025-71466.background_ko: 유효하지 않은 서비스 설명자로 인해 서비스명이나 제공자명이 NULL로 남은 상태에서 이를 역참조하는 것이 원인이다.

CVE-2025-71467.description: GPAC before 26.02.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_node_get_field_by_name() in src/scenegraph/base_scenegraph.c that lets attackers crash applications. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene referencing a never-created node to crash MP4Box or GPAC scene loader applications, causing denial of service.
CVE-2025-71467.summary_ko: GPAC 26.02.0 이전 버전에 널 포인터 역참조 취약점이 있어 MP4Box나 GPAC 장면 로더 애플리케이션이 중단되어 서비스 거부가 발생할 수 있다.
CVE-2025-71467.background_ko: 생성되지 않은 노드를 참조하는 XMT 장면을 처리할 때 gf_node_get_field_by_name()에서 널 포인터 역참조가 발생한다.

CVE-2025-71468.description: GPAC before 26.02.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_dash_group_get_audio_channels() in src/media_tools/dash_client.c that allows attackers to crash applications via crafted DASH manifests. Attackers can supply an MPD whose AudioChannelConfiguration element omits schemeIdUri or value, crashing MP4Box or GPAC DASH clients and causing denial of service.
CVE-2025-71468.summary_ko: GPAC 26.02.0 미만 버전의 gf_dash_group_get_audio_channels()에 NULL 포인터 역참조 취약점이 있다. 조작된 DASH 매니페스트로 MP4Box 또는 GPAC DASH 클라이언트가 충돌해 서비스 거부가 발생할 수 있다.
CVE-2025-71468.background_ko: AudioChannelConfiguration 요소에 schemeIdUri 또는 value가 없을 때 NULL 포인터를 역참조하는 것이 원인이다.

CVE-2025-71469.description: GPAC before 26.02.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in ctxload_process() that passes non-object descriptors to ODS_SetupOD() without checking the descriptor tag. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file with a URL-bearing descriptor that crashes MP4Box or other GPAC-based applications in gf_scene_ns_connect_object(), causing denial of service.
CVE-2025-71469.summary_ko: GPAC 26.02.0 이전 버전의 ctxload_process()에 타입 혼동 취약점이 있어 MP4Box나 다른 GPAC 기반 애플리케이션이 중단되어 서비스 거부가 발생할 수 있다.
CVE-2025-71469.background_ko: ctxload_process()가 디스크립터 태그를 확인하지 않고 객체가 아닌 디스크립터를 ODS_SetupOD()에 전달한다.

CVE-2025-71470.description: MicroQuickJS (mquickjs) before commit 99eed3f contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability because JS_Call() raises exceptions during frame setup without updating ctx->sp and ctx->fp. Attackers can supply JavaScript that calls a non-function value, causing build_backtrace() to walk stale frame pointers and crash the engine for denial of service.
CVE-2025-71470.summary_ko: 커밋 99eed3f 이전의 MicroQuickJS(mquickjs)에 범위를 벗어난 읽기 취약점이 있다. 조작된 자바스크립트로 엔진 충돌과 서비스 거부가 발생할 수 있다.
CVE-2025-71470.background_ko: JS_Call()이 프레임 설정 중 예외 발생 시 ctx->sp와 ctx->fp를 갱신하지 않아 build_backtrace()가 오래된 프레임 포인터를 따라가는 것이 원인이다.

CVE-2026-129484.description: Kroki before 0.36.0 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts via unvalidated svg-color-dark-scheme and svg-color-light-scheme options. Attackers can craft a GET /goat/svg URL whose option value closes the SVG style element, executing JavaScript in the Kroki origin when victims open it.
CVE-2026-129484.summary_ko: Kroki 0.36.0 미만 버전에 인증되지 않은 공격자가 스크립트를 주입할 수 있는 반사형 XSS 취약점이 있다. 피해자가 조작된 링크를 열면 Kroki 출처에서 자바스크립트가 실행될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-129484.background_ko: svg-color-dark-scheme 및 svg-color-light-scheme 옵션값을 검증하지 않는 것이 원인이다.

CVE-2026-129485.description: Kroki before 0.36.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the BlockDiag family of engines that allows unauthenticated attackers to make server requests via node icon and background attributes. Attackers can send crafted diagrams to POST /blockdiag/svg or sibling endpoints to query internal services or cloud metadata and read local image files from the server.
CVE-2026-129485.summary_ko: Kroki 0.36.0 미만 버전의 BlockDiag 계열 엔진에 서버 측 요청 위조(SSRF) 취약점이 있다. 인증되지 않은 공격자가 내부 서비스나 클라우드 메타데이터를 조회하고 서버의 로컬 이미지 파일을 읽을 수 있다.

CVE-2026-129490.description: littlefs through 2.11.3, when built with LFS_MIGRATE, contains a type confusion vulnerability in lfs_dir_traverse() that treats a stack lfs_diskoff struct as an lfs_attr array. Attackers can supply a crafted littlefs v1 image whose metadata is read as LFS_FROM_USERATTRS during migration, causing out-of-bounds stack reads and process crashes.
CVE-2026-129490.summary_ko: LFS_MIGRATE를 활성화해 빌드한 littlefs 2.11.3 이하 버전에 타입 혼동 취약점이 있다. 조작된 littlefs v1 이미지를 마이그레이션할 때 스택 범위를 벗어난 읽기와 프로세스 충돌이 발생할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-129490.background_ko: lfs_dir_traverse()가 스택의 lfs_diskoff 구조체를 lfs_attr 배열로 잘못 취급하는 것이 원인이다.

CVE-2026-125760.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Bit Apps Bit Assist bit-assist allows DOM-Based XSS.This issue affects Bit Assist: from n/a through 1.8.4.
CVE-2026-125760.summary_ko: Bit Apps의 Bit Assist 1.8.4 이하 버전에 DOM 기반 크로스사이트 스크립팅(XSS) 취약점이 있다.
CVE-2026-125760.background_ko: 웹 페이지 생성 시 입력값을 적절히 무해화하지 않는 것이 원인이다.

CVE-2026-125796.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Ahmad JS Help Desk js-support-ticket allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects JS Help Desk: from n/a through 5.0.5.
CVE-2026-125796.summary_ko: Ahmad의 JS Help Desk 5.0.5 이하 버전에 인가 누락 취약점이 있어, 잘못 구성된 접근 제어 보안 수준을 악용할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-125798.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Zaytech Smart Online Order for Clover clover-online-orders allows DOM-Based XSS.This issue affects Smart Online Order for Clover: from n/a through 1.6.6.
CVE-2026-125798.summary_ko: Zaytech의 Smart Online Order for Clover 1.6.6 이하 버전에 DOM 기반 크로스사이트 스크립팅(XSS) 취약점이 있다.
CVE-2026-125798.background_ko: 웹 페이지 생성 시 입력값을 적절히 무해화하지 않는 것이 원인이다.

CVE-2026-125804.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Meow Apps AI Engine ai-engine allows Stored XSS.This issue affects AI Engine: from n/a through 3.9.3.
CVE-2026-125804.summary_ko: Meow Apps의 AI Engine 3.9.3 이하 버전에 저장형 크로스 사이트 스크립팅(XSS) 취약점이 있다.
CVE-2026-125804.background_ko: 웹 페이지 생성 과정에서 입력값을 적절히 무력화하지 않는 것이 원인이다.

CVE-2026-125817.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Themeisle Feedzy feedzy-rss-feeds allows Stored XSS.This issue affects Feedzy: from n/a through 5.2.15.
CVE-2026-125817.summary_ko: Themeisle의 Feedzy 5.2.15 이하 버전에 저장형 크로스 사이트 스크립팅(XSS) 취약점이 있다.
CVE-2026-125817.background_ko: 웹 페이지 생성 과정에서 입력값을 적절히 무력화하지 않는 것이 원인이다.

CVE-2026-125818.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in AdvancedCoding wpDiscuz wpdiscuz allows Stored XSS.This issue affects wpDiscuz: from n/a through 7.6.75.
CVE-2026-125818.summary_ko: AdvancedCoding의 wpDiscuz 7.6.75 이하 버전에 저장형 크로스 사이트 스크립팅(XSS) 취약점이 있다.
CVE-2026-125818.background_ko: 웹 페이지 생성 과정에서 입력값을 적절히 무력화하지 않는 것이 원인이다.

CVE-2026-125822.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Nickboss WordPress File Upload wp-file-upload allows Stored XSS.This issue affects WordPress File Upload: from n/a through 5.2.3.
CVE-2026-125822.summary_ko: Nickboss의 WordPress File Upload 5.2.3 이하 버전에 저장형 크로스 사이트 스크립팅(XSS) 취약점이 있다.
CVE-2026-125822.background_ko: 웹 페이지 생성 과정에서 입력값을 적절히 무력화하지 않는 것이 원인이다.

CVE-2026-125823.description: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling vulnerability in Jegstudio Gutenverse gutenverse allows HTTP DoS.This issue affects Gutenverse: from n/a through 4.2.2.
CVE-2026-125823.summary_ko: Jegstudio의 Gutenverse 4.2.2 이하 버전에 HTTP 서비스 거부(DoS)를 유발할 수 있는 취약점이 있다.
CVE-2026-125823.background_ko: 제한이나 조절 없이 자원을 할당하는 것이 원인이다.

CVE-2026-125826.description: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability in Blubrry Podcasting PowerPress Podcasting powerpress allows Path Traversal.This issue affects PowerPress Podcasting: from n/a through 11.18.3.
CVE-2026-125826.summary_ko: Blubrry PowerPress Podcasting의 11.18.3까지 버전에 경로 순회 취약점이 있다.
CVE-2026-125826.background_ko: 경로명을 제한된 디렉터리 내부로 한정하는 처리가 미흡하다.

CVE-2026-125830.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Belingo belingoGeo belingogeo allows Reflected XSS.This issue affects belingoGeo: from n/a through 1.13.3.
CVE-2026-125830.summary_ko: Belingo의 belingoGeo 1.13.3 이하 버전에 반사형 크로스사이트 스크립팅(XSS) 취약점이 있다.
CVE-2026-125830.background_ko: 웹 페이지 생성 시 입력값을 적절히 무해화하지 않는 것이 원인이다.

CVE-2026-129091.description: Improper Control of Filename for Include/Require Statement in PHP Program ('PHP Remote File Inclusion') vulnerability in Mikado-Themes GrandPrix Core grandprix-core allows PHP Local File Inclusion.This issue affects GrandPrix Core: from n/a through 1.0.
CVE-2026-129091.summary_ko: Mikado-Themes의 GrandPrix Core 1.0 이하 버전에 PHP 로컬 파일 포함 취약점이 있다.
CVE-2026-129091.background_ko: PHP의 include/require 문에서 파일명을 적절히 제어하지 않는 것이 원인이다.

CVE-2026-123006.description: The repository search used by the dashboard (`GET /repo/search`) returned the internal commit status object of each repository. Since 28.0.0 that object included the repository owner's full user record, so any signed-in user could read the password hash, salt and email address of the owner of any repository they can see that has a commit status. The response now contains only the state and target URL of the commit status.
CVE-2026-123006.summary_ko: 28.0.0부터 대시보드의 저장소 검색을 통해 저장소 소유자의 비밀번호 해시, 솔트, 이메일 주소가 노출될 수 있습니다. 로그인한 사용자는 자신이 볼 수 있고 커밋 상태가 있는 저장소의 소유자 정보를 읽을 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-123006.background_ko: 저장소 검색이 내부 커밋 상태 객체를 반환했고, 28.0.0부터 이 객체에 저장소 소유자의 전체 사용자 레코드가 포함됐다.

CVE-2026-125423.description: A repository created with auto-init accepted pushes before its initialization had finished, and the initial commit was built in a checkout of whatever the repository already contained. A user who is allowed to create repositories could push a crafted tree during that window so that writing the README followed a symbolic link and overwrote a server-side git hook, which runs commands as the Gitea system user. The initial commit is now built in a freshly initialized directory, and a new repository only becomes ready, and accepts pushes, once its initialization is complete.
CVE-2026-125423.summary_ko: Gitea에서 저장소 생성 권한이 있는 사용자는 자동 초기화 도중 심볼릭 링크를 통해 서버 측 Git 훅을 덮어쓸 수 있습니다. 이로 인해 Gitea 시스템 사용자 권한으로 명령이 실행될 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-125423.background_ko: 자동 초기화가 끝나기 전에 푸시를 허용하고, 저장소에 이미 들어 있는 내용을 체크아웃한 디렉터리에서 초기 커밋을 생성했다.

CVE-2026-118389.description: The RubyGems package registry accepted gems whose platform, dependency names or dependency version requirements contain newline characters. Because the compact index served to clients is line-based, a user who can publish a gem to an owner's registry could forge index entries, such as packages that do not exist or additional versions of an existing gem with dependencies of their choice. Clients that resolve gems from that registry could then be led to install attacker-chosen dependencies. Gems with such metadata are now rejected.
CVE-2026-118389.summary_ko: RubyGems 패키지 레지스트리에서 gem 게시 권한이 있는 사용자가 인덱스 항목을 위조할 수 있습니다. 해당 레지스트리를 사용하는 클라이언트가 공격자가 선택한 의존성을 설치하도록 유도될 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-118389.background_ko: 줄 단위로 구성된 간결 인덱스를 사용하면서 플랫폼, 의존성 이름, 의존성 버전 요구사항에 줄바꿈 문자가 포함된 gem을 허용했다.

CVE-2026-118535.description: A repository registered by its owner as a source of scoped workflows kept that registration when it was transferred to another owner. The new owner could then change the workflows in the transferred repository, and they kept running in the previous owner's repositories with access to their Actions secrets and job tokens. A transfer now removes the owner-level registrations of the repository, and registrations whose source repository no longer belongs to the registering owner are ignored.
CVE-2026-118535.summary_ko: 범위 지정 워크플로의 소스로 등록된 저장소가 이전되면, 새 소유자가 변경한 워크플로가 이전 소유자의 저장소에서 계속 실행될 수 있습니다. 해당 워크플로는 이전 소유자의 Actions 시크릿과 작업 토큰에 접근할 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-118535.background_ko: 워크플로 소스 저장소가 다른 소유자에게 이전되어도 이전 소유자 수준의 소스 등록이 유지됐다.

CVE-2026-120725.description: With `REQUIRE_SIGNIN_VIEW = true`, the Git LFS endpoints still answered unauthenticated requests for repositories that are not private. An anonymous client who knows the path of such a repository and the SHA-256 of an LFS object could download the object, and could use the batch endpoint to test whether an object exists. The Git LFS endpoints now require authentication when sign-in is required to view the instance.
CVE-2026-120725.summary_ko: 인스턴스 조회에 로그인을 요구해도 비공개가 아닌 저장소의 Git LFS 엔드포인트는 인증 없이 접근할 수 있었다. 저장소 경로와 LFS 객체의 SHA-256을 아는 익명 사용자는 객체를 다운로드하거나 존재 여부를 확인할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-120725.background_ko: 인스턴스 조회에 로그인이 필요하도록 설정해도 비공개가 아닌 저장소의 Git LFS 엔드포인트는 인증을 요구하지 않았다.

CVE-2026-120729.description: The popup shown when hovering an issue reference loaded its data from the path of the hovered link and inserted part of the response as HTML. A user who can post a comment or other rendered content could add a link that is displayed as an ordinary issue reference but points to a file in a repository they control, so that the popup inserted that file's content into the page of anyone hovering the link and ran script in the viewer's session. The popup now requests the issue by the owner, repository and index parsed from the link.
CVE-2026-120729.summary_ko: 이슈 참조 미리보기 팝업에 XSS 취약점이 있다. 댓글 등 콘텐츠를 작성할 수 있는 사용자가 이를 악용해 링크에 마우스를 올린 열람자의 세션에서 스크립트를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-120729.background_ko: 팝업이 참조 링크의 경로에서 데이터를 불러온 뒤 응답 일부를 HTML로 삽입했다.

CVE-2026-120991.description: When a container blob upload was rejected, for example because it exceeded a package size quota, the cleanup removed the blob from storage even if the same content already existed and was used by other packages. On an instance with a package quota configured, a user who can upload container images and has the exact content of another owner's package file or image layer could make it undownloadable. The cleanup now only removes blobs that the failed upload created.
CVE-2026-120991.summary_ko: 컨테이너 블롭 업로드 실패 시 기존 공유 블롭까지 삭제될 수 있다. 패키지 할당량이 설정된 인스턴스에서 이미지 업로드 권한이 있고 다른 소유자의 패키지 파일이나 이미지 레이어의 정확한 내용을 가진 사용자가 해당 파일을 다운로드 불가 상태로 만들 수 있다.
CVE-2026-120991.background_ko: 업로드 거부 후 정리 작업이 실패한 업로드에서 새로 만든 블롭인지 구분하지 않고 다른 패키지가 사용하는 기존 블롭도 삭제했다.

CVE-2026-123002.description: Gitea accepted an unlimited number of wrong TOTP passcodes during sign-in, in the password reset flow and for Basic authentication with the `X-Gitea-OTP` header. An attacker who already knows an account's password could guess the six-digit passcode by trying codes at a high rate and sign in despite two-factor authentication. After five failed passcodes, further attempts for the account are now refused for 15 minutes.
CVE-2026-123002.summary_ko: Gitea에서 계정 비밀번호를 아는 공격자가 TOTP 코드를 반복 추측해 2단계 인증을 우회하고 로그인할 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-123002.background_ko: 로그인, 비밀번호 재설정, Basic 인증에서 잘못된 TOTP 코드의 입력 횟수를 제한하지 않았다.

CVE-2026-123009.description: When a file is edited in a fork through the web editor, Gitea can first copy a branch from the base repository into the fork. That copy did not check whether the user may read the base repository's code. A user who had forked a repository and later lost access to it, for example after it was made private or they were removed as a collaborator, could keep copying its current branches into their fork and read them. The copy now requires read access to the code of the base repository.
CVE-2026-123009.summary_ko: Gitea에서 저장소를 포크한 뒤 원본 접근 권한을 잃은 사용자가 원본의 최신 브랜치를 계속 자신의 포크로 복사해 읽을 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-123009.background_ko: 포크의 웹 편집기에서 원본 저장소의 브랜치를 복사할 때 사용자의 원본 코드 읽기 권한을 확인하지 않았다.

CVE-2026-123065.description: When a release was edited, the files of the attachments to remove were deleted by the identifiers submitted in the form rather than by the attachments verified to belong to the release. A user with write access to the releases of any repository, including their own, could submit a crafted identifier that resolves to the stored file of another attachment and delete it, provided they know that attachment's UUID. The attachment record stayed, so downloads of the affected issue, comment or release file failed. Release edits now only delete the files of attachments that belong to the release.
CVE-2026-123065.summary_ko: 릴리스 편집 과정에서 다른 이슈·댓글·릴리스 첨부파일의 저장 파일을 삭제해 다운로드를 막을 수 있다. 임의 저장소의 릴리스 쓰기 권한이 있고 대상 첨부파일의 UUID를 아는 사용자가 악용할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-123065.background_ko: 삭제할 파일을 릴리스 소속으로 검증된 첨부파일이 아니라 폼에서 제출된 식별자를 기준으로 결정했다.

CVE-2026-123638.description: The "Protected file patterns" setting of a branch protection rule was checked against file names as git prints them, and git quotes names that contain a double quote, a backslash or a control character. Such names never matched a pattern, so a user with write access could add or change files under a protected pattern by direct push or through a pull request merge, and could move a protected file out of the pattern's reach by renaming it. Where the patterns protect workflow files, this allowed adding a workflow that then ran on the repository's runners. Changed files are now listed unquoted, and a rename reports both the old and the new path.
CVE-2026-123638.summary_ko: 쓰기 권한이 있는 사용자가 브랜치 보호의 파일 패턴 검사를 우회해 보호 대상 파일을 추가·변경하거나 이름을 바꿀 수 있습니다. 워크플로 파일을 보호하는 경우 추가한 워크플로가 저장소 러너에서 실행될 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-123638.background_ko: 파일 패턴을 Git이 출력한 파일명과 비교했으며, 특수문자로 인해 인용 처리된 파일명은 패턴과 일치하지 않았다.

CVE-2026-123642.description: The AGit flow (pushing to `refs/for/...`) did not check the pusher's access to pull requests again when it created the pull request. A user or deploy key with read access to the code only, or with write access to the wiki over SSH, could open pull requests in a repository where they have no access to pull requests. Creating a pull request through AGit now requires read access to the pull requests of the repository and is refused for wiki pushes.

CVE-2026-125617.description: `GET /api/v1/users/{username}/orgs/{org}/permissions` only checked that the organization is visible to the caller and then returned the named user's role in it. Any signed-in user could learn whether another user is an owner, admin or member of a public or limited organization, including for members who conceal their membership. The roles are now only returned to the user themselves, to members of the organization and to site administrators.

CVE-2026-126338.description: Replying to a code review comment accepted a review ID that belongs to a different pull request, through the web form, the API and incoming mail replies. A signed-in user could reply on a pull request they can access with the ID of a review in a repository they cannot read, and the new comment was attached to that review and received the diff context of the commented lines. Replies are now only accepted for a review of the same pull request, and for a pending review only from its author.
CVE-2026-126338.summary_ko: 코드 리뷰 답글 처리에서 다른 풀 리퀘스트의 리뷰 ID가 허용돼, 로그인 사용자가 읽기 권한이 없는 저장소의 코드 변경 문맥을 열람할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-126338.background_ko: 웹 폼·API·메일 답글 처리 시 리뷰가 답글 대상 풀 리퀘스트에 속하는지 확인하지 않았다.

CVE-2026-127958.description: A pull request review created through the API as a draft (`event` set to `PENDING` or left empty) was added to the pull request timeline and announced through notifications and activity feeds like a submitted review. Its body and line comments were therefore visible to everyone who can read the pull request, including anonymous visitors of a public repository, before the reviewer submitted it. Pending reviews no longer get a timeline entry or notifications until they are submitted.

CVE-2026-128359.description: When Gitea acts as an OAuth2 or OpenID Connect provider, the token endpoint did not check the state of the user. After an administrator deactivated an account or prohibited its sign-in, existing refresh tokens and unused authorization codes of that user could still be exchanged for new tokens, so applications that sign users in through Gitea kept them signed in. The token endpoint now refuses users who may not sign in, and token introspection reports their tokens as inactive.
CVE-2026-128359.summary_ko: Gitea가 OAuth2 또는 OpenID Connect 제공자로 동작할 때, 비활성화되거나 로그인이 금지된 계정도 기존 갱신 토큰과 미사용 인가 코드로 새 토큰을 발급받을 수 있습니다. 이에 따라 연동 애플리케이션의 로그인 상태가 유지될 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-128359.background_ko: 토큰 엔드포인트가 사용자의 계정 상태를 확인하지 않았다.

CVE-2026-128365.description: Removing a team's review request looked up a review by the negated team ID, which for the team with ID 2 is the ID of the built-in Actions user, and marked the review it found as official. In the organization that owns that team, a user who can change the review requests of a pull request could make an approval left by the Actions user count toward the approvals required by branch protection. Merging still required permission to merge. Removing a team review request no longer changes any review.

CVE-2026-129337.description: Git over HTTP lowers the required permission for pushes to read access, so that the AGit flow works, and relies on the repository's server-side hooks to enforce write access. A repository that is still being created by a migration, fork or template generation has no hooks yet, so a user with read access to it could push branches and tags during that window, or after a failed migration that left the repository in that state. Git over HTTP now refuses requests to repositories that are still being created.
CVE-2026-129337.summary_ko: Git over HTTP에서 읽기 권한만 있는 사용자가 마이그레이션·포크·템플릿 생성 도중인 저장소에 브랜치와 태그를 푸시할 수 있습니다. 마이그레이션 실패로 저장소가 해당 상태에 남아 있는 경우에도 가능합니다.
CVE-2026-129337.background_ko: AGit 지원을 위해 푸시에 읽기 권한만 요구하고 쓰기 권한 검사를 서버 측 훅에 맡겼지만, 생성 중인 저장소에는 훅이 없었다.

CVE-2026-129341.description: The web endpoint that removes an attachment skipped the permission check when the request came from the user who had uploaded the attachment, and it was reachable with read access to issues or pull requests. A user who had uploaded a release asset could still delete it after losing write access to the repository. The endpoint now only deletes attachments that the user uploaded and that are not yet linked to an issue, comment or release.

CVE-2026-129525.description: Several endpoints that work on both issues and pull requests did not check which of the two the addressed item is. A user who can read a repository's issues but not its pull requests could read pull request data through the issue sub-resources of the API (timeline, attachments, labels, subscriptions, tracked times and reactions), and list pull requests through the repository's issue search and milestone pages; the same applied in the other direction. These endpoints now check read access to the unit the item belongs to. The API endpoints were fixed in 28.2.0 and 28.3.0, the search and milestone pages in 28.4.0.
CVE-2026-129525.summary_ko: 이슈와 풀 리퀘스트를 함께 처리하는 API 및 검색·마일스톤 페이지에 접근 통제 취약점이 있다. 이슈나 풀 리퀘스트 중 한쪽에만 읽기 권한이 있는 사용자가 다른 쪽 데이터를 조회할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-129525.background_ko: 요청 대상이 이슈인지 풀 리퀘스트인지 구분하지 않고 해당 항목 유형에 대한 읽기 권한을 검사하지 않았다.

CVE-2026-129491.description: Qbian61 forum-java commit 20f7e68 through commit 63152c4 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users to inject script by posting unsanitized comment content rendered via jQuery .html() in the reply dialog. Attackers can post comments with img onerror payloads that execute when victims click Reply, stealing the non-HttpOnly sid session cookie to hijack accounts including administrators.
CVE-2026-129491.summary_ko: Qbian61 forum-java의 커밋 20f7e68~63152c4에 저장형 XSS 취약점이 있다. 인증된 사용자의 악성 댓글이 답글 창에서 실행돼 세션 쿠키 탈취와 관리자 등을 포함한 계정 탈취로 이어질 수 있다.
CVE-2026-129491.background_ko: 정제하지 않은 댓글 내용을 답글 대화상자에서 jQuery .html()로 렌더링했다.

CVE-2026-129492.description: Bolo (bolo-solo) 1.7 through 2.6.4 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts via the unsanitized commentOriginalCommentName parameter. Attackers can post a comment to /article/comments with a short payload that steals non-HttpOnly session cookies from visitors, enabling takeover of administrator accounts.
CVE-2026-129492.summary_ko: Bolo (bolo-solo) 1.7~2.6.4에 저장형 XSS 취약점이 있다. 인증되지 않은 공격자가 방문자의 HttpOnly 미설정 세션 쿠키를 탈취해 관리자 계정을 장악할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-129492.background_ko: 댓글의 commentOriginalCommentName 매개변수 입력을 정제하지 않았다.

CVE-2026-129493.description: Bolo (bolo-solo) 1.7 through 2.6.4 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read article view passwords via the public GET /articles endpoint. Attackers can retrieve the plaintext articleViewPwd field returned by ArticleProcessor.getArticlesByPage and submit it to read password-protected article content.
CVE-2026-129493.summary_ko: Bolo (bolo-solo) 1.7~2.6.4의 공개 API에서 게시글 열람 비밀번호가 노출된다. 인증되지 않은 공격자가 비밀번호를 알아내 비밀번호로 보호된 게시글을 읽을 수 있다.
CVE-2026-129493.background_ko: 공개 게시글 조회 API가 articleViewPwd 필드에 게시글 열람 비밀번호를 평문으로 반환했다.

CVE-2026-129494.description: CloudPaste 1.1.0 through 1.9.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain WebDAV storage credentials through the unauthenticated /api/proxy/link endpoint. Attackers who know a public share slug can retrieve the Basic Authorization header containing the WebDAV username and password, then read, modify, or delete files on the WebDAV server.
CVE-2026-129494.summary_ko: CloudPaste 1.1.0~1.9.1에는 인증 없는 정보 노출 취약점이 있습니다. 공개 공유 식별자를 아는 공격자는 WebDAV 사용자 이름과 비밀번호를 획득해 WebDAV 서버의 파일을 읽거나 수정·삭제할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-129539.description: SSCMS 7.2.0 through 7.4.0 contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability that allows any registered user-center account to copy server files by supplying source paths to the layerImageUpload endpoint. Attackers can send siteId 0 with crafted filePaths entries to copy configuration files into their public sitefiles/home upload directory and download them anonymously.
CVE-2026-129539.summary_ko: SSCMS 7.2.0~7.4.0에는 등록된 사용자 센터 계정으로 악용할 수 있는 임의 파일 읽기 취약점이 있습니다. 서버의 설정 파일 등을 공개 업로드 디렉터리로 복사해 인증 없이 다운로드할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-129540.description: VoAPI 1.0.0 through 1.2.0 contains a sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to inject SQL by supplying crafted column names as search[...] filter keys on list endpoints such as GET /api/log. Attackers can read the HS256 JWT signing secret from the option table and forge a manager role token to take over the /api/m/* management API.
CVE-2026-129540.summary_ko: VoAPI 1.0.0~1.2.0의 목록 조회 엔드포인트에는 인증된 사용자가 악용할 수 있는 SQL 삽입 취약점이 있습니다. JWT 서명 비밀값 노출과 관리자 역할 토큰 위조로 관리 API가 장악될 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-129541.description: EdgeChat 2.5.0 through 2.21.0 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows invited users to inject HTML through unescaped usernames in the Vditor @-mention autocomplete. Attackers can register with a username containing an img onerror payload that executes when mentioned, stealing the localStorage session token to take over victim accounts.
CVE-2026-129541.summary_ko: EdgeChat 2.5.0~2.21.0의 Vditor @멘션 자동완성에 XSS 취약점이 있다. 초대된 사용자가 악성 사용자명을 통해 피해자의 localStorage 세션 토큰을 탈취하고 계정을 장악할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-129541.background_ko: Vditor @멘션 자동완성에서 사용자명을 이스케이프하지 않아 HTML로 해석됐다.

CVE-2026-129542.description: Files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability in Samsung Open Source Starfish allows Probe System Files.

CVE-2026-129543.description: Access of resource using incompatible type ('type confusion') vulnerability in Samsung Open Source Starfish allows Input Data Manipulation.

CVE-2026-107520.description: Dell PowerStore contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability. A low-privileged authenticated attacker could exploit this vulnerability, potentially leading to execution of malicious script in a higher-privileged user's session.
CVE-2026-107520.summary_ko: Dell PowerStore에 저장형 크로스사이트 스크립팅(XSS) 취약점이 있다. 인증된 낮은 권한의 공격자가 악용하면 더 높은 권한을 가진 사용자의 세션에서 악성 스크립트가 실행될 수 있다.

CVE-2026-82156.description: Dell PowerStore contains an authorization-bypass vulnerability. A low-privileged attacker could exploit it, potentially leading to elevation of privilege to administrator.
CVE-2026-82156.summary_ko: Dell PowerStore에 권한 검사를 우회할 수 있는 취약점이 있다. 낮은 권한의 공격자가 이를 악용하면 관리자 권한으로 상승할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-121786.description: The Social Viral Downloader WordPress plugin through 2.0.3 does not have authorisation or nonce checks on a log export action available to unauthenticated users, which could allow them to export the download log, including registered users' email addresses and IP addresses, to a publicly accessible file.
CVE-2026-121786.summary_ko: Social Viral Downloader WordPress 플러그인 2.0.3 이하 버전에서 비인증 사용자가 다운로드 로그를 공개 접근 가능한 파일로 내보낼 수 있다. 이 로그에는 등록 사용자의 이메일 주소와 IP 주소가 포함된다.
CVE-2026-121786.background_ko: 비인증 사용자가 접근할 수 있는 로그 내보내기 작업에 권한 확인과 논스(nonce) 검사가 없다.

CVE-2026-121787.description: The Social Viral Downloader WordPress plugin through 2.0.3 does not have authorisation or nonce checks on a log deletion action available to unauthenticated users, which could allow them to delete the Social Viral Downloader WordPress plugin through 2.0.3's entire download log.

CVE-2026-129606.description: Buffer Copy without Checking Size of Input ('Classic Buffer Overflow') vulnerability in Samsung Open Source mTower allows Overflow Buffers.

CVE-2026-105925.description: A denial of service vulnerability in the Qt QXmlSimpleReader class of the Qt 5 Core Compatibility APIs module (Qt 6) and the Qt XML module (Qt 5).
CVE-2026-105925.summary_ko: Qt 6의 Qt 5 Core Compatibility APIs 모듈과 Qt 5의 Qt XML 모듈에 포함된 QXmlSimpleReader 클래스에 서비스 거부 취약점이 있다.

CVE-2026-114453.description: The Kadence Memberships WordPress plugin before 4.0.6 does not check that the membership level submitted when renewing a membership matches the level being renewed, pricing the renewal from the submitted level while activating the membership at its own level, allowing unauthenticated users to activate a paid membership without paying on sites that also offer a free level.

CVE-2026-124672.description: The Burst Statistics WordPress plugin before 3.7.5 does not verify that a request is actually being routed to its own REST API before unloading every other active plugin for that request, allowing unauthenticated attackers to have requests processed with other plugins' protections (such as REST access restrictions, hidden login pages and two-factor authentication) switched off, and to cause other plugins' scheduled tasks to be discarded.

CVE-2026-129703.description: In the vulnerability-lookup web application, the authentication decorators for feed-key requests (auth_feedkey_func in website/decorators.py) and API-key requests (auth_func in website/web/api/v1/common.py) called Flask-Login's login_user() function. This caused the HTTP response to a request authenticated solely by a feed key (supplied as the X-FEED-KEY URL parameter) or an API key (supplied as the X-API-KEY header) to set a session cookie that grants full authenticated access to every page in the application, without requiring a password or two-factor authentication. The practical impact is that any party possessing a leaked feed URL (a common occurrence, as feed URLs are shared with RSS readers) or an API key could obtain a valid web session for the associated account. This session provides access to the user's account page, which exposes the API key and other profile data, and for accounts with the administrator role, access to the /admin interface, enabling full administrative control of the application. The vulnerability affects all users whose feed key or API key is exposed. No prior authentication, user interaction, or special network conditions are required; a single HTTP request with the token is sufficient to establish the session. The session persists until it expires, and because it is not bound to the original credential (a related CWE-613 issue noted by the developers), revoking the feed key or API key does not invalidate the already-created session. The fix replaces the login_user() call with assignment to g._login_user, which Flask-Login's current_user property reads for the current request only, without writing any session cookie. The affected views remain unchanged and continue to see the authenticated user for the single request.

CVE-2026-129706.description: In the vulnerability-lookup web application, the Flask-Login session identifier was set to the bare numeric user ID (User.get_id() returned self.id). Because the session ID contained no component derived from the user's credential, it remained valid indefinitely regardless of any subsequent password change, account recovery, or administrator-initiated password reset. An attacker who had obtained a valid session for a user account (for example through cross-site scripting, session hijacking, or a previously exposed feed or API key) could continue to access that user's account after the user changed their password, because the session cookie still carried the same static user ID and the user_loader accepted it without any credential-bound validation. The affected component is the session management layer of the vulnerability-lookup Flask application, specifically the User.get_id() method in website/models/user.py and the load_user callback in website/web/views/session_mgmt.py. The vulnerability required that an attacker already possessed a valid session for the target user; no additional authentication or special deployment configuration was needed beyond a standard deployment of the application. The security impact is that a user cannot effectively revoke an attacker's access by changing their password, performing an account recovery, or having an administrator reset the credential. The attacker retains full authenticated access to the user's profile, subscriptions, and any role-gated functionality for the lifetime of the session cookie. Additionally, sessions that were opened via a feed key or API key before a prior fix (commit 3605d5b6) also persisted indefinitely.

CVE-2026-102448.description: A vulnerability has been identified in Rexroth IndraWorks. This flaw allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the user’s system by parsing a manipulated file, because the file parser fails to properly sanitize the path name(s) or references embedded in the manipulated file. Exploitation requires user interaction, specifically opening a specially crafted file, which then causes the application to traverse outside the target directory and to write files in unauthorized locations, eventually enabling Remote Code Execution (RCE). This can lead to a complete compromise of the system running Rexroth IndraWorks.

CVE-2026-115690.description: Apache WSS4J remembers the UsernameToken Nonce, the Timestamp and signature of a signed message, and the ID of a SAML 2.0 "OneTimeUse" assertion, so that a captured message cannot be accepted twice. It checked whether a value had already been seen, validated the message, and only then remembered the value, as two separate steps. If several copies of the same message were processed at the same time, they could all pass the check before any of them was remembered, and all be accepted. An attacker who obtained a valid message before the recipient first processed it could send several copies at once, so that the same authenticated request was executed more than once. Where a UsernameToken is not bound to the message by a signature, the copies could carry different message bodies. The attacker needs to obtain the message while it is still in transit; a message captured after it has been accepted cannot be replayed. Affects deployments with a replay cache configured, as Apache CXF has by default. The value is now checked and remembered in a single atomic step. Custom ReplayCache implementations should override the new ReplayCache.addIfAbsent method with an operation that is atomic in their underlying store. Users are recommended to upgrade to versions 4.0.3 or 3.0.7 or 2.4.5, which fix this issue.

CVE-2026-128841.description: ** UNSUPPORTED WHEN ASSIGNED ** Missing authentication for critical function vulnerability in Apache Griffin Web Service. The REST API does not have any authentication. This includes sensitive endpoints, such as job submission when a Livy/Spark backend is configured. The API must be properly secured on the network level, and this fact was arguably not documented as clearly as it could have. This issue affects Apache Griffin Web Service: all versions. As this project is retired, we do not plan to release a version that fixes this issue. Users are recommended to find an alternative or restrict access to the instance to trusted users. NOTE: This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

CVE-2026-99289.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: ksmbd: fix app-instance non-durable supersede session UAF ksmbd_close_fd_app_instance_id() supersedes a prior open that has the same AppInstanceId. It reaches that open's session through opinfo->sess. This pointer is not refcounted. Session teardown detaches durable handles before it frees the session. It does not detach a non-durable open. That open still points at the session through opinfo->sess after the session is freed. Another session can supersede the open at the same time. The supersede then takes a write lock through the stale pointer, in the freed session's file table. BUG: KASAN: slab-use-after-free in _raw_write_lock+0x71/0xd0 Call Trace: _raw_write_lock+0x71/0xd0 ksmbd_close_fd_app_instance_id+0xd9/0x670 [ksmbd] smb2_open+0x3e10/0xd910 [ksmbd] Freed by task 212: ksmbd_session_destroy+0x38d/0x480 [ksmbd] Fix this by looking the session up by opinfo->session_id. The lookup returns a reference, as smb2_break_collect_channels() does. Recheck that opinfo->sess still points at it before using it. Do the lookup without m_lock held. destroy_previous_session() takes m_lock under the session table lock, and taking them in the other order here would deadlock.

CVE-2026-99290.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: ksmbd: fix use-after-free after a failed durable reconnect ksmbd_reopen_durable_fd() republishes a detached durable handle in the reconnecting session's file table and takes no reference for that entry. If smb2_open() then fails, cleanup relies on the final ksmbd_fd_put() to remove the volatile id. Two reconnects of the same handle can both take a lookup reference before either attaches it. If the one that reopens first then fails and drops its references first, the other request makes the final put through ksmbd_put_durable_fd(). That frees the handle without removing the first session's table entry, so tearing that session down writes to freed memory. BUG: KASAN: slab-use-after-free in __close_file_table_ids+0x14d/0x740 [ksmbd] Call Trace: __close_file_table_ids+0x14d/0x740 [ksmbd] ksmbd_destroy_file_table+0x76/0x100 [ksmbd] ksmbd_session_destroy+0xf8/0x480 [ksmbd] ksmbd_dispose_sessions+0x13e/0x200 [ksmbd] ksmbd_conn_sessions_cleanup+0x4c3/0x6d0 [ksmbd] Freed by task 1030: __ksmbd_close_fd+0x97d/0x1000 [ksmbd] smb2_open+0x14eb/0xd9f0 [ksmbd] Commit 3515503322f4 ("ksmbd: fix durable reconnect error path file lifetime") handles a final put made by the reconnecting request, but not one made by another holder. Remove the volatile id under the file-table lock on this error path, before the references are dropped, as ksmbd_close_fd() does on the request_open path just above. Removal then no longer depends on which holder makes the final put. The stale comment in the reconnect cleanup is updated to match. A successful reconnect is unchanged.

CVE-2026-99291.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: ksmbd: fix SMB2 CREATE response buffer overflow smb2_allocate_rsp_buf() uses the MAX_CIFS_SMALL_BUFFER_SIZE (448-byte) buffer for a single SMB2_CREATE response. That buffer also holds a 4-byte length field, which only leaves 444 bytes for the SMB2 body. The AAPL response made this buffer too small. After 8f1b796ff113, a request with AAPL response contexts may need at least 456 bytes. In the 456-byte case, create_aapl_rsp_buf() is appended last, clears 128 bytes, and writes 12 bytes past the allocation. KASAN reports: BUG: KASAN: slab-out-of-bounds in create_aapl_rsp_buf+0x31/0x6e0 Write of size 128 at addr ffff88800370954c by task kworker/0:0/9 ... create_aapl_rsp_buf+0x31/0x6e0 smb2_open+0x58f9/0xef10 ... smb2_allocate_rsp_buf+0x19d/0x370 ... The buggy address is located 332 bytes inside of allocated 448-byte region [ffff888003709400, ffff8880037095c0) Reserve enough space for any fixed CREATE response KSMBD can build. Store the required allocation size in the per-dialect values table. This keeps the small buffer for other commands and avoids using the max transaction buffer for every CREATE.

CVE-2026-99292.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: smb: client: fix slab-out-of-bounds write in id_mode_to_cifs_acl() In id_mode_to_cifs_acl(), while the chown branch reserves sizeof(struct smb_ntsd) + 2 * sizeof(struct smb_sid) (plus sizeof(struct smb_acl) and the worst-case ACE space after commit 0ee150794c75 ("smb: client: fix heap overflow in DACL owner/group rewrite")), the chmod branch only adds 2 * sizeof(struct smb_ace) or 5 * sizeof(struct smb_ace) to secdesclen (or 1 * sizeof(struct smb_ace) on posix). However, the chmod branch also invokes build_sec_desc() -> copy_sec_desc(), which unconditionally writes the Owner SID at pnntsd + sidsoffset and the Group SID at pnntsd + sidsoffset + sizeof(struct smb_sid) (2 * 68 = 136 bytes total), and set_chmod_dacl() always writes a struct smb_acl header (8 bytes) even when the source descriptor has dacloffset == 0. When a security descriptor has compact or overlapping Owner/Group SIDs (or dacloffset == 0), calling chmod() under-allocates pnntsd and writes past the end of the slab buffer. Reserve sizeof(struct smb_acl) + 2 * sizeof(struct smb_sid) (plus sizeof(struct smb_ntsd) on the posix path) in the chmod branch of id_mode_to_cifs_acl().

CVE-2026-99293.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: fuse: don't BUG when the copy buffer is exhausted fuse_copy_fill() hits BUG_ON(!err) once the iterator backing the copy runs out of pages. Over io-uring the amount copied is not bounded by the payload buffer the server registered, so an unprivileged user can drain the iterator and panic the host - mount a FUSE filesystem with small payload buffers, then setxattr() a larger value: kernel BUG at fs/fuse/dev.c:1064! Oops: invalid opcode: 0000 [#1] SMP KASAN NOPTI CPU: 1 UID: 0 PID: 148 Comm: exploit Not tainted 7.3.0-rc1 #2 RIP: 0010:fuse_copy_fill (fs/fuse/dev.c:1033) Call Trace: <TASK> fuse_copy_args (fs/fuse/dev.c:1354 fs/fuse/dev.c:1380) fuse_uring_args_to_ring (fs/fuse/dev_uring.c:891) fuse_uring_prepare_send (fs/fuse/dev_uring.c:940 fs/fuse/dev_uring.c:1057) fuse_uring_send_in_task (fs/fuse/dev_uring.c:1745) tctx_task_work_run (io_uring/tw.c:96) tctx_task_work (io_uring/tw.c:133) task_work_run (kernel/task_work.c:233) io_run_task_work (io_uring/tw.h:84) io_cqring_wait (io_uring/wait.c:278) __do_sys_io_uring_enter (io_uring/io_uring.c:2676) do_syscall_64 (arch/x86/entry/syscall_64.c:61) entry_SYSCALL_64_after_hwframe (arch/x86/entry/entry_64.S:121) The reply path can drain it the same way, via the server-supplied payload_sz in fuse_uring_copy_from_ring(). Return -EIO instead. All three fuse_copy_fill() callers already propagate the error.

CVE-2026-99294.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: netfilter: nft_fwd_netdev: use recursion counter in neigh egress path nft_fwd_neigh can be used in egress chains (NF_NETDEV_EGRESS). When the forwarding rule targets the same device or two devices forward to each other, neigh_xmit() triggers dev_queue_xmit() which re-enters nf_hook_egress(), causing infinite recursion and stack overflow. Move the nf_get_nf_dup_skb_recursion() accessor and NF_RECURSION_LIMIT to the shared header nf_dup_netdev.h as a static inline, so that nft_fwd_netdev can use the recursion counter directly without exported function call overhead. Guard neigh_xmit() with the same recursion limit already used in nf_do_netdev_egress(). [ Updated to cache the nf_get_nf_dup_skb_recursion pointer. --pablo ]

CVE-2026-99295.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: smb: client: stop processing a read response after a receive error cifs_read_iter_from_socket() may call cifs_reconnect() before returning an error. The reconnect path aborts pending mids and invokes their callbacks. The callback can then release the cifs_io_subrequest containing rdata. cifs_readv_receive() nevertheless continues after a negative return and may dereference rdata in cifs_readv_discard(). KASAN reports the resulting UAF: BUG: KASAN: slab-use-after-free in cifs_readv_receive Read of size 4 by task cifsd cifs_readv_receive (fs/smb/client/transport.c:1284) cifs_demultiplex_thread (fs/smb/client/connect.c:1355) kthread (kernel/kthread.c:436) ret_from_fork (arch/x86/kernel/process.c:158) Freed by task 148: netfs_put_subrequest (fs/netfs/objects.c:267) netfs_read_collection (fs/netfs/read_collect.c:460) netfs_wait_for_in_progress (fs/netfs/misc.c:462) Return the socket error immediately, as this path did before the iterator conversion. This also avoids adding a negative length to total_read.

CVE-2026-99296.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: libceph: bound mon_command ack decode to front len handle_command_ack() bounds the decode with msg->front_alloc_len, the size of the reply buffer, instead of msg->front.iov_len, the number of bytes the monitor sent. mon_alloc_msg() routes every CEPH_MSG_MON_COMMAND_ACK to get_generic_reply(), which returns the preallocated ->reply of whichever generic request carries the same tid, so the buffer keeps its fixed size however short the reply is. An ack with hdr.front_len below sizeof(struct ceph_mon_request_header) + sizeof(u32), including 0, still passes ceph_decode_need(), and ceph_decode_32() returns four bytes that were never received: uninitialized slab memory, stale bytes of an earlier message, or bytes the peer planted by sending a reply that lands in the same buffer and is then rejected. The read stays within the allocation, so KASAN does not flag it. req->result reaches userspace through ceph_monc_do_statfs(), ceph_monc_get_version() and ceph_monc_blocklist_add(); rbd hands it back from write() on /sys/bus/rbd/add_single_major, and rbd_get_client() passes it to ERR_PTR() unchecked, which faults: rbd: failed to get latest osdmap: -186318427 BUG: unable to handle page fault for address: fffffbfffe9ca034 Oops: Oops: 0000 [#1] SMP KASAN NOPTI RIP: 0010:do_rbd_add (drivers/block/rbd.c:7105) Call Trace: ... kernfs_fop_write_iter (fs/kernfs/file.c:345) vfs_write (fs/read_write.c:595 fs/read_write.c:687) ksys_write (fs/read_write.c:739) do_syscall_64 (arch/x86/entry/syscall_64.c:61 arch/x86/entry/syscall_64.c:84) entry_SYSCALL_64_after_hwframe (arch/x86/entry/entry_64.S:121) Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception Use msg->front.iov_len, matching handle_subscribe_ack(), handle_statfs_reply(), handle_get_version_reply() and handle_auth_reply(). A well-formed ack has front.iov_len >= 22 and is unaffected; a short one takes the existing bad: path. This applies commit d3c32939fa0e ("libceph: bound get_version reply decode to front len") to the last decode-side use of front_alloc_len in this file.

CVE-2026-99298.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: net: ipv4: add zero check for snd_cwnd_clamp When RTAX_CWND is locked, user is able to pass 0 into it. CVE-2026-99299.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: media: em28xx: reject audio endpoint with zero packet size em28xx_audio_urb_init() divides by the audio endpoint's wMaxPacketSize without checking it, so a USB device that declares a zero-sized audio endpoint divides by zero at probe time. CVE-2026-99300.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: media: go7007: only set audio_enabled if go7007_snd_init() succeeded go7007_register_encoder() sets go->audio_enabled before calling go7007_snd_init() and discards its return value. go7007_snd_init() assigns go->snd_context only on success, so a failed ALSA setup leaves audio_enabled set with snd_context still NULL. The disconnect path tests audio_enabled and calls go7007_snd_remove(), which dereferences snd_context unconditionally. go7007_snd_init() returns -ENODEV once its never-decremented static card counter reaches SNDRV_CARDS, so SNDRV_CARDS attach/detach cycles arm the next attach; no memory pressure is needed. Set go->audio_enabled only once go7007_snd_init() has succeeded. Oops: general protection fault, probably for non-canonical address ... CVE-2026-99301.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: virtio_net: atomically disable rx mode work virtio-net uses a boolean to gate rx_mode_work during device teardown. The flag is changed under RTNL, but ndo_set_rx_mode checks it under the address-list lock. A callback can therefore pass the check and enqueue work after teardown has flushed it. The work is also enabled before late probe operations that can fail, allowing probe unwind to free the netdev with work still queued. KASAN reports the worker using a virtqueue that probe unwind already freed: BUG: KASAN: slab-use-after-free in virtqueue_add_split Workqueue: events virtnet_rx_mode_work Call Trace: virtqueue_add_split (drivers/virtio/virtio_ring.c:706) virtqueue_add_sgs (drivers/virtio/virtio_ring.c:2839) virtnet_send_command_reply (drivers/net/virtio_net.c:3565) virtnet_rx_mode_work (drivers/net/virtio_net.c:3833) process_one_work (kernel/workqueue.c:3322) worker_thread (kernel/workqueue.c:3405) Freed by task 119: kfree (mm/slub.c:6625) vp_del_vq.isra.0 (drivers/virtio/virtio_pci_common.c:259) vp_del_vqs (drivers/virtio/virtio_pci_common.c:285) virtnet_probe (drivers/net/virtio_net.c:7129) Use the workqueue disable mechanism to atomically reject new queue attempts and drain running work. Keep work disabled until probe succeeds or restore has reattached the netdev, then enable it and replay receive-mode state for a running interface. Disable it before resource teardown in freeze and remove.

CVE-2026-99302.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: nvmet-rdma: reject short connection requests nvmet_rdma_parse_cm_connect_req() treats RDMA-CM private data as a struct nvme_rdma_cm_req but accepts any nonzero private_data_len. The iWARP path allocates exactly the peer-provided length, so a six-byte MPA request reaches the parser and the hsqsize load reads two bytes past the allocation. CVE-2026-99303.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: speakup: Fix NULL pointer dereference on VT switch + selection When selecting/pasting very quickly after VT switch, the tty is not set yet, leading to a NULL dereference. We can just abort the operation.

CVE-2026-99304.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: ceph: fix integer overflow in the snap trace bounds check ceph_update_snap_trace() bounds the two encoded snapid arrays that follow a struct ceph_mds_snap_realm with sizeof(u64) * (num_snaps + num_prior_parent_snaps). Both counts come straight off the wire as __le32, so the addition is evaluated in unsigned int and wraps before sizeof(u64) promotes it to size_t: an MDS sending num_snaps = 1 and num_prior_parent_snaps = 0xffffffff makes the sum zero and the check degenerates to ceph_decode_need(&p, e, 0, bad), which always passes. dup_array() then reads num_snaps * 8 bytes past the end of the message front, which ceph_msg_new2() allocates at exactly front_len bytes. An unsolicited CEPH_MSG_CLIENT_SNAP reaches this from a malicious or compromised MDS with no client-side action, as do the snaptraces carried in an MDS reply and in a cap import. Compute the length with size_add()/size_mul() so it saturates at SIZE_MAX instead of wrapping, in the style fs/ceph/mdsmap.c already uses for num_export_targets. CVE-2026-99305.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: fbdev: udlfb: don't rebuild the mode list while the framebuffer is in use dlfb_setup_modes() frees info->modelist with fb_destroy_modelist() and rebuilds it, but fbcon holds raw pointers into that list in fb_display[i].mode and nothing un-publishes them the way do_unregister_framebuffer() and store_modes() do with fbcon_delete_modelist(). The function does refuse to install a new mode while the framebuffer has users (dlfb->fb_count != 0), but only after the list is already destroyed. Reached from the 0666 "edid" sysfs attribute, an unprivileged write to /sys/class/graphics/fb0/edid therefore fails with -EINVAL and still leaves every fb_display[i].mode dangling; the next console switch reads the freed fb_videomode in fb_videomode_to_var(). Test fb_count before touching the list. fbcon takes a reference through fbcon_open(), so that condition covers exactly the states in which fb_display[] points into the list, and the errno returned to userspace is unchanged. CVE-2026-99306.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: ceph: reject mdsmaps that claim more than CEPH_MAX_MDS ranks check_new_map() sizes its export-target bitmap from CEPH_MAX_MDS but walks it with newmap->possible_max_rank, which comes straight off the wire: ceph_mdsmap_decode() sets it to max(m_num_active_mds, m_max_mds), then overwrites it with the size of the "in" set. Neither is bounded by CEPH_MAX_MDS, only by m_info allocating, so a monitor announcing more ranks than the bitmap holds makes test_bit() read past the end of targets[]. The clear_bit() loop above indexes the same bitmap, though it is additionally bounded by mdsc->max_sessions. The map arrives on the monitor connection, which is unauthenticated in legacy msgr mode. CEPH_MAX_MDS is a protocol constant from src/mds/mdstypes.h, and the reserved inode ranges in super.h are laid out one rank apart over that span, so a map claiming more ranks is corrupt. Reject it where the rank space is established rather than letting the count reach check_new_map(). CVE-2026-99307.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: ceph: require the dentry lease record to cover struct ceph_mds_reply_lease parse_reply_info_lease() reads a 32-bit struct_len off the wire and only checks that many bytes are present, without requiring struct_len to cover sizeof(struct ceph_mds_reply_lease) (10 bytes). A malicious MDS can declare a shorter record and still get the pointer published: the following *p += sizeof(**lease) overshoot is undone by *p = lend, so nothing downstream rejects the reply. ceph_fill_trace() -> update_dentry_lease() then reads 10 bytes through that pointer on any lookup on a mounted CephFS, running past the end of the message front. Require the record to cover the structure, matching the sibling parse_reply_info_dir(). A conforming MDS always encodes the full 10 bytes.
