e2629ce7ac7cf750706b722a.title_ko: last30days-skill, 여러 온라인 출처를 조사·요약하는 AI 에이전트 스킬
e2629ce7ac7cf750706b722a.summary_ko: last30days-skill은 Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket과 웹에서 주제를 조사하는 AI 에이전트용 스킬이다. 저장소 설명에 따르면 조사한 내용을 종합해 근거에 기반한 요약을 만든다.

curation.reason_ko: 여러 커뮤니티·웹 자료를 조사해 요약하는 에이전트 스킬로, 당일 별 122개가 확인됐다.

a3e1d6942539881cbacba401.excerpt: web development for the rest of us

bcb2a2de7aaec5bc6e39633e.excerpt: Modern Docker Management, Designed for Everyone
bcb2a2de7aaec5bc6e39633e.title_ko: Arcane, 폭넓은 사용자를 위한 Docker 관리 도구
bcb2a2de7aaec5bc6e39633e.summary_ko: Arcane은 Docker 관리를 위한 도구다. 누구나 사용할 수 있도록 설계된 현대적인 관리 환경을 표방한다.

curation.reason_ko: Docker 관리 도구라는 구체적 개발 용도가 제시됐으며, 당일 별 31개가 확인됐다.

CVE-2024-58407.description: Microsoft jxrlib through 1.1 and the mircomir jxrlib fork before 1.3.1 contain a global buffer over-read vulnerability in DecodeSignificantRun() in image/decode/segdec.c due to an unchecked run length. Attackers can supply a crafted JPEG XR file with an out-of-range iMaxRun value that indexes gSignificantRunBin[] out of bounds, causing memory disclosure or crashes during decoding.

CVE-2024-58408.description: Microsoft jxrlib through 1.1 and the mircomir jxrlib fork before 1.3.1 contain a global buffer over-read vulnerability in initLookupTables() in image/decode/strdec.c caused by an unchecked bit depth index. Attackers can supply a crafted JPEG XR file with an out-of-range bit depth in the image header to read beyond the cbChannels array, causing crashes or memory disclosure.

CVE-2025-5809.description: An improper privilege management vulnerability in an LDAP extension used with OpenText eDirectory could require a technical or proxy user to be granted write permission to the ACL when only permission to modify a specific LDAP attribute is intended. A user who possesses the proxy user's credentials could use the excessive ACL permission to modify access rights for objects within the affected container, potentially resulting in unauthorized elevation of privilege. The issue is addressed in OpenText eDirectory 25.2.

CVE-2026-127043.description: Insecure direct object reference (IDOR) in the myGESTIÓN Time Tracking module. The server skips the permission check when processing the “worker” parameter. By modifying this parameter, an authenticated user can view other users' time logs, including those of administrators.

CVE-2026-127044.description: Insecure direct object reference (IDOR) in the STEL Order Tempo module. The server retrieves data based on the `empleadoId` parameter without checking the user's permissions. By modifying this parameter, an authenticated user can view the first name, last name, role, job title, and vacation days of other employees.

CVE-2026-129851.description: SeaweedFS before 4.42 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the VolumeServer.FetchAndWriteNeedle gRPC method that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass the incomplete CVE-2026-73080 fix. Attackers can supply crafted replicas[].url entries or an azure_endpoint to make the volume server send requests with controlled tokens and bodies to internal services and metadata addresses.
CVE-2026-129851.summary_ko: SeaweedFS 4.42 이전 버전의 VolumeServer.FetchAndWriteNeedle gRPC 메서드에 서버 측 요청 위조 취약점이 있다. 인증되지 않은 공격자가 볼륨 서버를 통해 내부 서비스와 메타데이터 주소로 토큰과 본문이 조작된 요청을 보내게 할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-129851.background_ko: CVE-2026-73080 수정이 불완전하며, 복제본 URL이나 Azure 엔드포인트 값으로 서버의 요청 대상을 제어할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-129852.description: SeaweedFS before 4.42 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to probe local files by supplying a filesystem path in gcs_google_application_credentials. Attackers can send crafted gRPC FetchAndWriteNeedle requests and use differing error messages to learn file existence, readability, and partial content shape on the host.

CVE-2026-129853.description: LimeSurvey before 6.17.16+260814 and 7.x before 7.0.10+260813 contains an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability in the public statistics page via POST parameter names. Attackers can submit backtick-containing parameter names to buildSelects() and use blind techniques to read administrator password hashes and survey responses on MySQL or MariaDB.

CVE-2026-129854.description: RedAmon 4.0.0 before 7.8.0 contains a missing object-level authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to control other tenants' agent sessions by supplying arbitrary session ids. Attackers can call /api/agent/sessions, interact and kill routes to list, kill, or send commands into other users' meterpreter and shell sessions on their compromised targets.
CVE-2026-129854.summary_ko: RedAmon 4.0.0 이상 7.8.0 미만 버전에서 인증된 사용자가 다른 테넌트의 에이전트 세션을 제어할 수 있다. 다른 사용자의 meterpreter·셸 세션을 조회·종료하거나 명령을 보낼 수 있다.
CVE-2026-129854.background_ko: 에이전트 세션에 대한 객체 수준 권한 검사가 없어 임의의 세션 ID로 다른 테넌트의 세션에 접근할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-129855.description: RedAmon before 7.8.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the kali-sandbox terminal server that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain a root shell by connecting to its WebSocket listener on port 8016. Attackers who can reach the port from co-resident containers or the host loopback can send keystrokes to an interactive /bin/bash session, executing commands as root inside the kali-sandbox container.

CVE-2026-129856.description: wallabag 2.3.3 before 2.6.16 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts through article author metadata rendered with Twig raw in entry.html.twig. Attackers can embed HTML event handlers in a web page's author metadata so scripts run in a victim's wallabag session when the saved entry is opened, exposing their data.

CVE-2026-129857.description: Microsoft jxrlib through 1.1 and the mircomir jxrlib fork before 1.3.1 contain a heap buffer overflow in ReadBinaryData() in jxrgluelib/JXRMeta.c caused by integer overflow of the metadata count. Attackers can supply a JPEG XR file with a count of 0xFFFFFFFE or 0xFFFFFFFF, wrapping PKAlloc(uCount + 2) to an undersized buffer that the following file read overflows, corrupting heap memory in decoding applications.
CVE-2026-129857.summary_ko: Microsoft jxrlib 1.1 이하와 mircomir jxrlib 포크 1.3.1 미만에 힙 버퍼 오버플로 취약점이 있다. 조작된 JPEG XR 파일로 디코딩 애플리케이션의 힙 메모리가 손상될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-129857.background_ko: 메타데이터 개수의 정수 오버플로로 너무 작은 버퍼가 할당되고, 뒤이은 파일 읽기가 버퍼 범위를 넘는다.

CVE-2026-129858.description: Microsoft jxrlib through 1.1 and the mircomir jxrlib fork before 1.3.6 contain a stack buffer over-read vulnerability in ReadWMIHeader() in image/decode/strdec.c due to an unterminated signature buffer. Attackers can supply a crafted JPEG XR file whose 8 signature bytes contain no zero byte, causing strstr to read past the stack buffer and potentially crash the application.

CVE-2026-129859.description: Microsoft jxrlib through 1.1 and the mircomir jxrlib fork before 1.3.1 contain a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in ImageStrDecDecode() in image/decode/strdec.c. Attackers can supply a crafted JPEG XR file declaring a colour format with no channels, leaving p1MBbuffer[0] NULL and crashing the decoder via memset.

CVE-2026-129860.description: Microsoft jxrlib through 1.1 and the mircomir jxrlib fork before 1.3.7 contain a reachable assertion vulnerability in ParsePFDEntry() that allows attackers to abort applications via an invalid orientation tag. Attackers can supply a crafted JPEG XR file with an out-of-range WMP_tagTransformation value to crash applications using default assertion-enabled builds, or store an unchecked orientation value otherwise.

CVE-2026-129861.description: @tinacms/graphql 2.2.2 through 4.1.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users to write files outside the content root by following pre-existing dangling symlinks. Attackers can create documents through the GraphQL API targeting a dangling symlink, bypassing assertWithinBase checks, to write controlled content such as authorized_keys to server-writable locations.

CVE-2026-129862.description: Koillection before 1.8.6 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to view objects nested under private parents through the shared search autocomplete route. Attackers can query GET /user/{username}/search/autocomplete/{term}, whose native SQL filters on visibility instead of final_visibility, to obtain names, ids and counts of hidden collections, items, albums and wishlists.

CVE-2026-129863.description: GitBucket through 4.48.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to edit and merge other users' pull requests because the PATCH pulls and PUT pulls merge REST API endpoints only check read access. Attackers can close, reopen, retitle, retarget, or merge pull requests into the base branch without write permission on public repositories or as private-repository guest collaborators.
CVE-2026-129863.summary_ko: GitBucket 4.48.0 이하에서 인증된 사용자가 쓰기 권한 없이 다른 사용자의 풀 리퀘스트를 수정하거나 기준 브랜치에 병합할 수 있다. 공개 저장소 또는 게스트 협업자로 참여한 비공개 저장소에서 악용할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-129863.background_ko: 풀 리퀘스트 수정·병합 REST API가 읽기 권한만 확인한다.

CVE-2026-129864.description: Frappe CRM before 1.84.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the get_deal_contacts method that allows authenticated low-privileged users to read contacts of deals they cannot access. Attackers can supply or iterate CRM Deal names to obtain linked contacts' full names, email addresses, and mobile numbers, bypassing row-level permission rules.

CVE-2026-129865.description: Dinky through 1.2.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in DataSourceController.testConnect that allows any authenticated user to open arbitrary JDBC connections by supplying caller-controlled connection settings. Attackers can probe internal hosts and ports via returned driver errors, or supply a MySQL JDBC URL enabling local-infile against a malicious server to read files from the Dinky host.

CVE-2026-129866.description: Dinky through 1.2.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in ClusterConfigurationController that allows authenticated users without cluster configuration permissions to list Flink cluster configurations. Attackers can query the /api/clusterConfiguration/list and listAll endpoints to retrieve full configJson deployment settings for every cluster in their tenant.

CVE-2026-129867.description: Rocboss paopao-ce through 0.6.0-alpha.3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows registered users to inject script by abusing #topic link wrapping in preparePost and parsePostTag. Attackers can publish posts or comments with a crafted topic containing a lone '<' and event handler to steal the PAOPAO_TOKEN JWT from localStorage and take over viewer accounts.

CVE-2026-129868.description: Rocboss paopao-ce through 0.6.0-alpha.3 fails to validate the attachment_price field when creating posts, allowing authenticated users to set negative prices on charge attachments. Attackers with two ordinary accounts can download the attachment via GET /v1/attachment, where the negative price increases the buyer's wallet balance, minting funds to purchase other users' paid attachments.

CVE-2026-129869.description: SamWaf 1.0.128 through 1.3.25-beta.11 contains a request body inspection bypass vulnerability in WafEngine.ServeHTTP that skips bodies with chunked encoding or lengths of 2048 bytes or more. Remote unauthenticated attackers can send SQL injection, XSS, command injection, traversal or upload payloads chunked or padded, which reach the protected backend uninspected.

CVE-2026-129870.description: Rocboss paopao-ce 0.2.0 through 0.6.0-alpha.3 contains a path traversal vulnerability in LocalOSS DeleteObject that allows authenticated users to delete arbitrary files by submitting crafted media values. Attackers can send dot-dot-slash sequences in the avatar or media content to POST /v1/user/avatar or POST /v1/post/comment, deleting server-writable files including configuration and data.

CVE-2026-129871.description: Rocboss paopao-ce through 0.6.0-alpha.3 contains a payment bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain paid attachments by reading storage URLs from the GET /v1/post endpoint. Attackers can download the paid file directly from the unauthenticated LocalOSS /oss static route, whose signed URL expired parameter is never checked.

CVE-2026-129872.description: REBUILD 2.7.0 through 4.5.4 contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to inject AjQL conditions through the plan parameter of /project/tasks/list. Attackers can use priority-* plans and the returned task count as a boolean oracle to recover a task creator's SHA-256 password hash and log in as that user, including the administrator.

CVE-2026-129873.description: REBUILD 4.3.0 through 4.5.4 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to obtain a SYSTEM_USER token by requesting /commons/file-preview with an arbitrary src value. Attackers can read the leaked _csrfToken from the redirect Location header and send it as X-AuthToken to access the admin center and administrative APIs.
CVE-2026-129873.summary_ko: REBUILD 4.3.0~4.5.4에 권한 상승 취약점이 있다. 낮은 권한의 인증된 사용자가 파일 미리보기 기능에서 유출되는 SYSTEM_USER 토큰을 얻어 관리자 센터와 관리 API에 접근할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-129873.background_ko: 파일 미리보기 응답의 리디렉션 Location 헤더로 SYSTEM_USER의 _csrfToken이 유출되며, 이 값이 인증 토큰으로 사용될 수 있다.

CVE-2026-129874.description: REBUILD 3.5.0 through 4.5.4 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to modify their own roleId through mass assignment in /app/entity/record-save and /app/entity/common-save. Attackers can submit their own User record with roleId set to the built-in administrator role, bypassing updatable=false restrictions to gain full administrator privileges.
CVE-2026-129874.summary_ko: REBUILD 3.5.0~4.5.4에 권한 상승 취약점이 있다. 낮은 권한의 인증된 사용자가 자신의 사용자 레코드에 있는 역할 정보를 변경해 완전한 관리자 권한을 얻을 수 있다.
CVE-2026-129874.background_ko: 사용자 레코드 저장 시 대량 할당으로 roleId를 변경할 수 있으며, updatable=false 제한이 우회된다.

CVE-2026-129875.description: REBUILD 4.5.0 through 4.5.4 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to recover the administrator password hash by filtering User.password through the MCP QueryRecords tool. Attackers can send LK2 prefix-match filters to the /gw/mcp/sse gateway and use the returned total count as an oracle to extract the SHA-256 hash one character at a time, then log in as administrator.
CVE-2026-129875.summary_ko: REBUILD 4.5.0~4.5.4의 정보 노출 취약점으로 낮은 권한의 인증된 사용자가 MCP QueryRecords 도구를 통해 관리자 비밀번호의 SHA-256 해시를 복원하고 관리자 계정으로 로그인할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-129875.background_ko: MCP QueryRecords가 User.password 필터를 허용하고 일치 건수를 반환해 비밀번호 해시를 추론할 수 있는 정보를 노출한다.

CVE-2026-129876.description: OfficeCLI 1.0.56 through 1.0.161 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the officecli watch preview that allows attackers to inject script via unescaped numbering w:color values. Attackers can craft a DOCX whose color closes the style element, then abuse the unauthenticated /api/batch endpoint to read local files and modify the watched document.

CVE-2026-129877.description: DeepAudit 2.0.0-beta.1 through 3.8.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve server secrets through the /api/v1/config/defaults endpoint. Attackers can send a GET request to obtain the operator's LLM provider API keys and GitHub or GitLab tokens, then abuse those services and accessible repositories.
CVE-2026-129877.summary_ko: DeepAudit 2.0.0-beta.1~3.8.0에서 인증 없이 서버 비밀정보를 조회할 수 있다. LLM 제공업체 API 키와 GitHub·GitLab 토큰이 유출돼 관련 서비스와 접근 가능한 저장소가 악용될 수 있다.

CVE-2026-129878.description: DeepAudit 2.0.0-beta.1 through 3.8.0 contains an HTML injection vulnerability in ReportGenerator.generate_task_report that allows registered users to read server files and perform SSRF. Attackers can create a project whose name contains a link attachment element and download the task PDF report to retrieve local files or internal network responses.

CVE-2026-129879.description: DeepAudit 2.0.0-beta.1 through 3.8.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users to write arbitrary files by importing projects with crafted IDs. Attackers can set absolute or ../ project IDs via /api/v1/database/import, then upload ZIPs through /api/v1/scan/upload-zip following cloned symlinks to overwrite app/main.py for remote code execution.
CVE-2026-129879.summary_ko: DeepAudit 2.0.0-beta.1~3.8.0의 경로 순회 취약점으로 인증된 사용자가 임의 파일을 쓸 수 있다. 애플리케이션 파일을 덮어써 원격 코드를 실행할 수도 있다.
CVE-2026-129879.background_ko: 프로젝트 가져오기에서 절대 경로나 상위 디렉터리 경로를 포함한 ID가 허용되며, ZIP 업로드 시 복제된 심볼릭 링크를 따라 파일이 기록된다.

CVE-2026-129880.description: DeepAudit 2.0.0-beta.5 through 3.8.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows registered users to leak server-wide GitLab or Gitea tokens via repository_url. Attackers can create a gitlab or gitea project pointing to a controlled host and request its branches to capture the operator's token and reach internal hosts.

CVE-2026-129881.description: Weblate 2026.6 through 2026.11.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in ChangeManager.last_changes() that exposes workspaces the viewer cannot view by skipping Workspace.can_view() checks site-wide. Anonymous visitors on instances with REQUIRE_LOGIN disabled and only public projects can query /changes/, /api/changes/, or RSS/CSV feeds to obtain hidden workspace names, UUIDs, actions, and timestamps.

CVE-2026-129882.description: Kiwi TCMS before 17.1 contains a hard-coded cryptographic key vulnerability that allows remote attackers to forge signed data by using the publicly known Django SECRET_KEY in tcms/settings/common.py. Attackers can forge or tamper with signed cookie-based messages and django.core.signing payloads, weakening password-reset and session-authentication HMACs on deployments keeping the default.

CVE-2026-129883.description: thirdweb Dashboard through commit 940b3745 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows remote attackers to send users to arbitrary sites by supplying an unvalidated redirectUri parameter on the /pay/[id] payment link page. Attackers can distribute payment links with a malicious redirectUri that PayPageWidget opens via window.open after payment without noopener, enabling phishing and reverse tabnabbing of the payment page.

CVE-2026-129884.description: thirdweb Dashboard through commit 940b3745 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the fetchClientSecret Next.js server action that allows unauthenticated attackers to create Stripe checkout sessions for other teams. Attackers can invoke the action with a forged Team object containing a victim's stripeCustomerId to obtain Growth plan Checkout session client secrets with attacker-influenced return URLs.

CVE-2026-129885.description: Unrolled Secure before 1.18.0 contains an SSLRedirect bypass vulnerability in Secure.isSSL() that trusts the client-supplied r.URL.Scheme to determine HTTPS transport. Attackers can send plaintext HTTP requests with an absolute-form https:// request-target to skip the HTTPS redirect and have application responses served unencrypted.

CVE-2026-129886.description: thirdweb Dashboard through commit 940b3745 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in revalidatePathAction and revalidateCacheTagAction server actions in revalidate.ts. Unauthenticated attackers can use action identifiers exposed in the client bundle to send POST requests that purge cached pages and data, forcing repeated regeneration and degrading performance.

CVE-2026-129887.description: thirdweb Dashboard through commit 940b3745 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read non-public team metadata by requesting the team join page with any invite ID. Attackers who know a team slug can obtain the serialized Team object, exposing billing email, billing status, Stripe customer ID, verified domain and support identifiers.

CVE-2026-129888.description: Cetmix Tower through 17.0.3.0.0 and 18.0 before 18.0.4.0.1 contains an improper SSH host key verification vulnerability in SSHConnection.connect() that falls back to Paramiko's AutoAddPolicy when no host key is pinned. On-path attackers using ARP or DNS spoofing can present their own host key during Skip Host Key or Get from Host connections to capture stored SSH passwords and tamper with commands and files.

CVE-2026-129940.description: Prime CMS (@primecms/core) through 0.4.0-beta.0 contains an open redirect vulnerability in the unauthenticated GET /prime/redirect route that allows remote attackers to redirect users to external sites. Attackers can craft links with a 36-character id and arbitrary url parameter on the trusted Prime host to send victims to phishing sites.

CVE-2026-129941.description: Prime CMS (@primecms/core) through 0.4.0-beta.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to register accounts via the createUser mutation on /prime/graphql. Because the isAuthenticated() guard has its check commented out and createAbility() hard-codes every role to admin, attackers can log in with full administrative control over content, users, webhooks and settings.
CVE-2026-129941.summary_ko: Prime CMS(@primecms/core) 0.4.0-beta.0 이하 버전에 인증 우회 취약점이 있다. 인증되지 않은 공격자가 계정을 등록하고 관리자 권한으로 로그인해 콘텐츠, 사용자, 웹훅, 설정을 제어할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-129941.background_ko: isAuthenticated()의 인증 검사가 주석 처리되어 있고, createAbility()가 모든 역할을 관리자로 고정한다.

CVE-2026-129942.description: Prime CMS (@primecms/core) through 0.4.0-beta.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to invoke privileged GraphQL mutations because the @Authorized() decorator is omitted. Attackers can call updateWebhook, createRelease, unpublishDocument and updateUser at /prime/graphql to create releases and, with a record UUID, redirect webhooks, unpublish documents, or overwrite user profiles.

CVE-2026-129943.description: Prime CMS (@primecms/core) through 0.4.0-beta.0 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the updateSystem GraphQL mutation that allows authenticated administrators to execute shell commands via the package version string. Attackers can append shell metacharacters to the unvalidated version value, which is passed to child_process.exec() in yarn add or npm install commands, executing commands as the server process.

CVE-2026-129944.description: Keystatic through 0.6.9 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the getIsPathValid function that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to access sibling paths sharing a content directory name prefix. Attackers can send requests with a no-cors header to the blob, update, and tree handlers under /api/keystatic to read, create, overwrite, or delete files such as posts-evil/pwn.yaml.

CVE-2026-129945.description: Keystatic through 0.6.9 contains a login cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the githubOauthCallback handler that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to sign victims in with the attacker's GitHub account by omitting state validation. Attackers can induce victims to visit the OAuth callback with an attacker-obtained authorization code, causing victim edits in the admin UI to be committed under the attacker's GitHub identity.

CVE-2026-129946.description: Keystatic through 0.6.9 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the DocumentRenderer component that allows authenticated content editors to inject scripts via unvalidated link href values. Editors can paste anchors with javascript: URLs into document fields, executing script when visitors click rendered links and stealing the keystatic-gh-access-token cookie.

CVE-2026-129947.description: Contentlayer @contentlayer/core through 0.3.4 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows attackers to inject JavaScript by embedding single quotes in content file names. Attackers can add a content file whose name breaks out of the import specifier in makeDataExportFile(), executing injected code when contentlayer dev or a Next.js dev server imports the generated module.

CVE-2026-129948.description: Contentlayer @contentlayer/source-files through 0.3.4 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows attackers who control content files to execute JavaScript by abusing gray-matter's still-enabled JavaScript engine in parseMarkdown(). Attackers can start a Markdown or MDX file with a ---js or ---javascript frontmatter delimiter to run code during build, exposing CI build secrets.
CVE-2026-129948.summary_ko: Contentlayer의 @contentlayer/source-files 0.3.4 이하 버전에 코드 주입 취약점이 있다. 콘텐츠 파일을 제어하는 공격자가 빌드 중 JavaScript를 실행해 CI 빌드 비밀정보를 노출시킬 수 있다.
CVE-2026-129948.background_ko: parseMarkdown()에서 사용하는 gray-matter의 JavaScript 엔진이 활성화되어 있어 Markdown·MDX 프런트매터의 코드가 실행될 수 있다.

CVE-2026-129949.description: Rowy through 3.0.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users with table write access to inject unsanitized HTML into Markdown cells. Attackers can store iframe, object, or form elements with javascript: URLs that execute when administrators view the table, stealing Firebase sessions.

CVE-2026-129950.description: Rowy through 3.0.0 contains an incorrect permission assignment vulnerability in default Firebase Storage rules that grants any user holding a role read and write access to the entire bucket. Authenticated users restricted to a single table or read-only access can use the Firebase SDK directly to list, download, overwrite, and delete any stored files.

CVE-2026-129951.description: Rowy through 3.0.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users with table write access to inject scripts via URL field links lacking scheme validation. Attackers can store values like javascript: URIs containing the string http in URL cells, executing script when victims click the open-link button to steal Firebase sessions.

CVE-2026-129952.description: NodePress through 8.5.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to gain administrator access by forging JWTs with the hardcoded 'nodepress-secret' fallback key. Attackers can sign HS256 bearer tokens with the default issuer, audience, and role 'admin' to access administrator-only APIs for article, comment, options, and file management.
CVE-2026-129952.summary_ko: NodePress 8.5.1 이하 버전에는 인증 우회 취약점이 있다. 인증되지 않은 원격 공격자가 JWT를 위조해 관리자 권한을 얻고 게시글, 댓글, 옵션, 파일 관리용 관리자 API에 접근할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-129952.background_ko: JWT 서명에 사용할 대체 비밀 키가 하드코딩되어 있어 공격자가 유효한 토큰을 위조할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-129953.description: NodePress through 8.5.1 contains a rate limit bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to evade throttling by spoofing the X-Forwarded-For header, because trustProxy is enabled. Attackers can send X-Forwarded-For set to 127.0.0.1 or rotate values to brute-force the administrator password via POST /admin/login and evade comment IP blocklists.

CVE-2026-129954.description: NodePress through 8.5.1 contains an HTML injection vulnerability in linesToEmailContent() that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject markup into notification emails because comment content is not escaped. Attackers can post comments or replies via POST /comments containing forged links, images, or tracking resources rendered in administrator and author mail clients from the blog's address.

CVE-2026-129955.description: NodePress through 8.5.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to gain administrator access by using the hardcoded default password 'root'. Attackers can send base64-encoded 'root' to POST /admin/login when NP_ADMIN_DEFAULT_PASSWORD is unset to obtain admin tokens and fully control the site.
CVE-2026-129955.summary_ko: NodePress 8.5.1 이하 버전에는 하드코딩된 기본 비밀번호로 인한 인증 우회 취약점이 있다. 관련 환경 변수가 설정되지 않은 경우 인증되지 않은 공격자가 관리자 토큰을 얻어 사이트를 완전히 제어할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-129955.background_ko: NP_ADMIN_DEFAULT_PASSWORD가 설정되지 않으면 하드코딩된 기본 관리자 비밀번호를 사용한다.

CVE-2026-129956.description: Sandboxie-Plus before 1.18.6 contains a local privilege escalation vulnerability in SbieSvc that allows standard users to launch UpdUtil.exe as SYSTEM via MSGID_PROCESS_RUN_UPDATER requests. Attackers can inject code into a signed SandMan.exe process to bypass the signature check and write attacker-controlled files to arbitrary paths, achieving SYSTEM code execution.
CVE-2026-129956.summary_ko: Sandboxie-Plus 1.18.6 이전 버전의 SbieSvc에 로컬 권한 상승 취약점이 있다. 일반 사용자가 서명 검사를 우회해 임의 경로에 파일을 쓰고 SYSTEM 권한으로 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-129956.background_ko: 서명된 SandMan.exe 프로세스에 주입된 코드로 SbieSvc의 서명 검사를 우회할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-129957.description: PrestaShop before 8.2.9 and 9.0.0 before 9.2.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability in back-office theme and module archive import that allows authenticated employees to write files outside intended directories. Attackers can craft a theme name in config/theme.yml or upload a module archive extracted before validation to place PHP files in web-accessible locations and execute code.
CVE-2026-129957.summary_ko: PrestaShop 8.2.9 미만 및 9.0.0 이상 9.2.1 미만의 백오피스 테마·모듈 압축 파일 가져오기에 경로 순회 취약점이 있다. 인증된 직원이 지정된 디렉터리 밖에 파일을 써 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-129957.background_ko: 모듈 압축 파일을 검증하기 전에 해제하는 문제가 있다.

CVE-2026-3859.description: XSS vulnerability in Vibe Versions <= 4.0.8.7 could allow an attacker to inject malicious JavaScript through crafted search input.

CVE-2026-3860.description: CSRF vulnerability in OpenText Vibe versions <= 4.0.8.7 could expose the token over an insecure connection or make it accessible to JavaScript, weakening protection against forged requests.

CVE-2026-28731.description: A memory corruption vulnerability exists in VideoLAN VLC 3.0.23. A specially crafted Interplay MVE file can trigger a condition that allows access to a variable that is not explicitly initialized, which under certain conditions can lead to code execution in the context of the current process.
CVE-2026-28731.summary_ko: VideoLAN VLC 3.0.23에 메모리 손상 취약점이 있다. 조작된 Interplay MVE 파일을 처리하면 특정 조건에서 현재 프로세스 내 코드 실행으로 이어질 수 있다.
CVE-2026-28731.background_ko: Interplay MVE 파일 처리 중 명시적으로 초기화되지 않은 변수에 접근할 수 있는 상태가 발생한다.

CVE-2026-32789.description: An out-of-bounds read vulnerability exists in VideoLAN VLC 3.0.23. By using a specially crafted NUV file, an attacker could exploit this vulnerability to perform an out-of-bounds read, potentially leading to the disclosure of sensitive information.

CVE-2026-100101.description: On Linux and other Unix-like systems, LibreOffice can send the current document as an email attachment with File > Send > Email Document, which starts the mail client through a script bundled with LibreOffice. The script let the shell interpret the name of the document's file, so a file with a crafted name could run commands when it was sent by email. In fixed versions the script passes the file name and the other details to the mail client as plain arguments.
CVE-2026-100101.summary_ko: Linux 등 Unix 계열의 LibreOffice에서 문서를 이메일 첨부로 전송할 때 조작된 문서 파일명으로 인해 명령이 실행될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-100101.background_ko: 메일 클라이언트를 실행하는 LibreOffice 포함 스크립트가 문서 파일명을 셸이 해석하도록 처리했다.

CVE-2026-101351.description: LibreOffice can import PICT images, which may be embedded in documents. Parts of a crafted image could be left unwritten, so leftover memory became part of the imported image and could be saved with the document. In fixed versions the pixels of a new image start out cleared, so any part the image data does not fill is blank.

CVE-2026-101352.description: A document can carry its own user interface customizations, such as keyboard shortcuts, menus and toolbars, which take effect while the document is open. A command bound in these customizations could run a macro or a script even when the macro security settings did not allow the macros of the document, so a user who pressed a shortcut or chose a menu item in a crafted document could run code without any warning. In fixed versions the customizations of a document are treated like its other macro content, and the macro and script commands in them are only kept when the macros of the document are allowed.
CVE-2026-101352.summary_ko: 문서에 포함된 단축키나 메뉴 명령을 사용하면 매크로 보안 설정이 문서의 매크로를 금지하더라도 경고 없이 코드가 실행될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-101352.background_ko: 문서의 사용자 인터페이스 사용자 지정에 연결된 매크로·스크립트 명령에 문서의 매크로 보안 제한이 적용되지 않았다.

CVE-2026-101353.description: LibreOffice Base documents can contain an embedded HSQLDB database, and other documents can use such a database as a data source. The definition of the database in a crafted document could make the database engine create or write files at locations outside the document, chosen by the document. In fixed versions the files of an embedded database are kept in a private location, and an embedded database cannot create table files anywhere else.

CVE-2026-101892.description: LibreOffice documents in ODF format can contain form controls, such as buttons and text fields, and each control names the component that implements it. The component a control named was created even when it was not a form control, and the settings stored with the control were applied to it, so a crafted document could change the configuration of LibreOffice in a way that led to code being run. In fixed versions a control whose component is not a form control is ignored.
CVE-2026-101892.summary_ko: LibreOffice에서 조작된 ODF 문서의 양식 컨트롤을 통해 프로그램 설정이 변경되고 코드가 실행될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-101892.background_ko: 양식 컨트롤이 지정한 구성 요소가 실제 양식 컨트롤이 아니어도 생성하고, 컨트롤에 저장된 설정을 해당 구성 요소에 적용했다.

CVE-2026-101929.description: LibreOffice documents can contain Basic macro libraries. A library protected by a password is stored in the document in a compiled form, which may be read when the document is loaded. When a value in the compiled form used an older record format, it could be read as a different type from the one the existing value held, which corrupted memory. In fixed versions the existing value is cleared before a value in the older format is read.

CVE-2026-101930.description: LibreOffice Writer can open HTML documents, and an HTML document can bind macros to events of the document as a whole, such as the document being opened or closed. Macros bound to these events were not taken into account by the macro security check, so they could run when the document was opened, whatever the macro security level. In fixed versions these macros follow the macro security settings like any other macro in the document.
CVE-2026-101930.summary_ko: LibreOffice Writer에서 HTML 문서를 열면 문서 이벤트에 연결된 매크로가 매크로 보안 수준과 관계없이 실행될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-101930.background_ko: 매크로 보안 검사에서 HTML 문서 전체의 열기·닫기 이벤트에 연결된 매크로를 검사 대상에 포함하지 않았다.

CVE-2026-101933.description: LibreOffice documents can contain Basic macro libraries. A library protected by a password is stored in the document in a compiled form, which may be read when the document is loaded. An out-of-bounds write existed when the compiled form was read, because the positions of its strings were not checked against the size of the data they refer to, and a type found by name was not checked to be of the right kind. In fixed versions these positions are checked, a library that fails the check is not loaded, and a type of the wrong kind is ignored.

CVE-2026-104007.description: LibreOffice can connect to databases through JDBC drivers written in Java. A spreadsheet can use a database as the source of a pivot table, and the database document that describes the connection names the driver to use. The location the driver was loaded from was taken from the database document itself, so a crafted document could make LibreOffice load and run Java code that the document supplied when it was opened. This is a different route to the problem fixed for CVE-2026-63277. In fixed versions the driver location is taken only from the driver configuration of the user, and a pivot table whose source is a database document named by a URL connects only once the user allows links to be updated.
CVE-2026-104007.summary_ko: LibreOffice의 피벗 테이블용 데이터베이스 연결에서 조작된 문서를 열면 문서가 제공한 Java 코드가 JDBC 드라이버로 로드·실행될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-104007.background_ko: JDBC 드라이버를 불러올 위치를 데이터베이스 문서 자체에서 가져왔다.

CVE-2026-104692.description: LibreOffice bundles the HSQLDB database engine, which can be used through the generic JDBC database driver as well as through the support for embedded databases. HSQLDB lets SQL statements call Java methods, limited to the classes that are permitted. When HSQLDB was used through the generic JDBC driver this limit did not apply, so SQL in a crafted document could call any Java method and run code. In fixed versions SQL can call only the built-in functions of HSQLDB, whichever way the database is reached.
CVE-2026-104692.summary_ko: LibreOffice에 포함된 HSQLDB를 일반 JDBC 드라이버로 사용할 때, 조작된 문서의 SQL이 임의의 Java 메서드를 호출해 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-104692.background_ko: HSQLDB를 일반 JDBC 드라이버로 사용할 때 SQL에서 호출할 수 있는 Java 클래스 제한이 적용되지 않았다.

CVE-2026-104920.description: LibreOffice Calc can link a cell range to an external data source, and the link is saved in the document. A Java database driver for such a link is loaded from a class path. Opening a crafted document could still load a Java database driver from a location outside the local machine and run its code, by a route that the fix for CVE-2026-63277 did not cover. In fixed versions an entry in a Java class path has to be a file URL that names a file on the local machine.
CVE-2026-104920.summary_ko: LibreOffice Calc에서 외부 데이터 원본에 연결된 조작된 문서를 열면 로컬 컴퓨터 밖의 Java 데이터베이스 드라이버가 로드되고 해당 코드가 실행될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-104920.background_ko: Java 데이터베이스 드라이버의 클래스 경로에 로컬 컴퓨터 밖의 위치도 허용됐으며, 이 로드 경로는 기존 수정에 포함되지 않았다.

CVE-2026-104933.description: LibreOffice can embed audio and video in documents. Where it plays media with GStreamer, as on Linux, the media is opened when the document is loaded, and a preview image of a video is shown in the document and in its exports, such as PDF. A crafted media file could make GStreamer read a local file and draw its text into the preview image, so that the content of the file ended up in an exported document. This is a different route to the problem fixed for CVE-2026-63269. In fixed versions GStreamer opens only media in a short list of common, self-contained container formats.

CVE-2026-106535.description: libvisio is a library that reads drawings in the VSD and VSDX formats. LibreOffice and other applications use it to import such drawings. An out-of-bounds write existed when a crafted VSDX file contained a malformed path from one part of the drawing to another. In fixed versions a malformed path is handled without writing outside its data.

CVE-2026-108169.description: LibreOffice can open a web query file (.iqy), which names a web page to import into a spreadsheet, when the file is given on its command line, for example when a file manager or another program opens the file with LibreOffice. The address in such a file was used without the checks that apply to an address given on the command line directly, so a crafted file could make LibreOffice do something other than open a web page, up to running code. In fixed versions only an http or https address is taken from a web query file.
CVE-2026-108169.summary_ko: LibreOffice에서 명령줄 인수로 전달된 웹 쿼리 파일(.iqy)을 열면, 조작된 파일의 주소로 인해 웹 페이지 열기 이외의 동작이나 코드 실행이 발생할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-108169.background_ko: 웹 쿼리 파일에서 가져온 주소에 명령줄로 직접 전달된 주소에 적용되는 검사를 수행하지 않았다.

CVE-2026-113630.description: Command injection in the documentserver-flush-cache.sh maintenance helper in ONLYOFFICE Docs (Document Server) 9.4.0-129 on the official onlyoffice/documentserver container allows a local attacker with command execution as the ds user to execute arbitrary commands as root via a crafted --hash argument that is interpolated unvalidated into a GNU sed expression, where the sed e flag runs attacker-controlled commands. The packaged sudoers policy permits ds to run the helper as root without a password and with unrestricted arguments.
CVE-2026-113630.summary_ko: 공식 onlyoffice/documentserver 컨테이너의 ONLYOFFICE Docs 9.4.0-129에서 ds 사용자 권한으로 명령을 실행할 수 있는 로컬 공격자가 명령 주입으로 root 권한의 임의 명령을 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-113630.background_ko: 유지보수 스크립트가 검증하지 않은 인수를 명령 실행이 가능한 sed 표현식에 삽입하며, sudoers 정책은 ds의 해당 스크립트 root 실행을 비밀번호나 인수 제한 없이 허용한다.

CVE-2026-113631.description: Incorrect authorization in the sendForm RPC handler and Session JWT reconnect handling in ONLYOFFICE Docs (Document Server) 9.4.0-129 on the official onlyoffice/documentserver container allows an authenticated view-only user to export a reconstructed copy of a document, including content the viewer never displayed such as custom XML, custom document properties and field instruction text, even when download and form-filling are disabled. The attacker reconnects with a valid Session JWT while substituting an attacker-controlled callback URL, which the Session JWT does not bind, then invokes sendForm over RPC, causing DocumentServer to send the reconstructed DOCX to that URL.
CVE-2026-113631.summary_ko: 공식 onlyoffice/documentserver 컨테이너의 ONLYOFFICE Docs 9.4.0-129에서 인증된 읽기 전용 사용자가 다운로드와 양식 입력이 차단돼도 문서 사본을 내보낼 수 있다. 사본에는 뷰어에 표시되지 않은 사용자 지정 XML·문서 속성·필드 명령문도 포함될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-113631.background_ko: sendForm RPC의 인가 검증이 부적절하고, 재연결 처리에서 Session JWT가 콜백 URL에 바인딩되지 않는다.

CVE-2026-129235.description: Kubeshark is an eBPF-powered network observability tool for Kubernetes. From 53.1.0 until 53.4.0, the download_file tool in cmd/mcpRunner.go accepts caller-controlled path and dest values, fetches a selected Kubeshark Hub API response, and writes the returned bytes through os.Create(dest) in callDownloadFile without confining the destination. An attacker who influences arguments through an AI agent driving kubeshark mcp can write Hub-supplied bytes to any path writable by the local MCP user and can read captured network traffic from default auth-disabled Hub deployments. The tool is registered without --allow-destructive; reliable code execution is not demonstrated because the bytes are constrained to Hub API responses. Hub-side default authentication remains outside this remediation, so captured traffic can remain readable in default auth-disabled Hub deployments after the local destination-write fix. The destination-write issue is fixed in version 53.4.0.

CVE-2026-129236.description: Kubeshark is an eBPF-powered network observability tool for Kubernetes. From 53.1.0 until 53.4.0, the start_kubeshark MCP tool in cmd/mcpRunner.go uses callStartKubeshark to append caller-controlled pod_regex as a bare positional argument to kubeshark tap without a -- end-of-options separator, allowing a value beginning with --set to be parsed as a Helm value override. An attacker who influences tool arguments against kubeshark mcp --allow-destructive can redirect the privileged worker, Hub, and front images through tap.docker.registry and tap.docker.tag to an attacker-controlled registry. Because the deployed worker DaemonSet runs privileged with host networking and host filesystem access, a malicious image can obtain node and cluster-admin access when the host already has permission to deploy it. This issue is fixed in version 53.4.0.

CVE-2026-129237.description: qbee-agent is the device agent component of the qbee.io IoT device management platform. Prior to 2026.41, the unpackTar extraction logic in app/utils/tar.go validates cleaned archive entry paths with strings.HasPrefix(targetPath, destdirClean) without enforcing a path-separator boundary. When UseContext enables the Docker Compose build context path in app/configuration/bundle_docker_compose.go, a less-privileged archive supplier with delegated configuration and/or file-manager access can provide a sibling-prefix traversal entry that passes the check, causing utils.UnpackTar to create directories and regular files outside the intended context extraction directory with qbee-agent process privileges, despite the supplier lacking authority to write those sibling files. In deployments where only full device or fleet administrators can provide Docker Compose context archives, this behavior is hardening rather than a crossed security boundary. The demonstrated impact is limited to nearby cache or project paths sharing the destination prefix, may affect integrity or availability of qbee-agent-managed Docker Compose state, and does not establish arbitrary absolute-path writes or direct code execution. This issue is fixed in version 2026.41.

CVE-2026-129239.description: Directus is a real-time API and App dashboard for managing SQL database content. Prior to 12.3.1, Directus allows an authenticated non-admin with update permission on directus_shares to modify user_created, role, item, and collection on an existing owned share because authorization checks the pre-update row and does not revalidate the merged row. The update path does not force user_created to the acting user or rerun share access checks when item or collection changes. Setting user_created and role to administrator identifiers causes guest share authentication to derive administrator accountability from both fields, exposing data reachable from the shared item beyond the owner and share role permissions. The issue requires update permission on directus_shares, an item the account can share, and knowledge of administrator user and role identifiers, and it does not issue an administrator token or provide write or availability impact. This issue is fixed in version 12.3.1.

CVE-2026-18563.description: LibreOffice supports fonts embedded in documents. When a document is exported to PDF, the fonts it uses are embedded in the PDF, and a font in CFF (Compact Font Format) is converted to another font format on the way. An out-of-bounds write existed when the charstring program of a crafted font was interpreted, because some indexes and ranges taken from the font were not checked against the size of the data they refer to. In fixed versions these indexes and ranges are checked, and a font that fails the checks is not converted.

CVE-2026-18564.description: LibreOffice can export documents to PDF protected by a password. With the PDF 2.0 option the file is encrypted with 256-bit AES, using a file encryption key and salts that are meant to be random. The key and the salts were drawn from a pseudo-random number generator that is not suitable for cryptography, so the encryption key of an exported PDF could be recovered without knowing the password. In fixed versions the key and the salts are drawn from the random source of the operating system.
CVE-2026-18564.summary_ko: LibreOffice에서 PDF 2.0 옵션으로 내보낸 암호 보호 PDF는 암호를 몰라도 파일 암호화 키가 복구될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-18564.background_ko: 파일 암호화 키와 솔트를 암호학적 용도에 적합하지 않은 의사난수 생성기에서 생성했다.

CVE-2026-18565.description: LibreOffice has an option, called stealth mode in earlier advisories, that stops documents from outside the trusted file locations from loading linked images and other content. The option is not on by default. With the option on, a linked background image in an HTML document was still fetched while the document was imported. In fixed versions a linked background image is checked against the option like other linked images, and is not fetched when the option blocks it.

CVE-2026-18566.description: LibreOffice can import EMF, EMF+ and WMF images, which may be embedded in documents. Several out-of-bounds reads existed in the readers for these formats, because sizes, counts and offsets taken from a crafted image were not checked against the data the image actually holds. In fixed versions these values are checked against the size of each record and the data that remains, and a record that fails the checks is not used.

CVE-2026-64890.description: : Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information vulnerability in Johnson Controls Open Blue Companion Android App on Android allows : Retrieve Embedded Secrets from Software. This issue affects Open Blue Companion Android App: before R2.22.0.

CVE-2026-84234.description: LibreOffice can open PDF files in Draw, where the PDF import converts each page into drawing objects that can be edited. Images in the PDF, including images with a transparency mask, are converted along the way. An out-of-bounds write existed when an image with a transparency mask was converted, because positions taken from a crafted image were not checked against the size of the image buffer. In fixed versions the image size is limited, and the position of each mask pixel is checked before it is written.

CVE-2026-84443.description: LibreOffice Base documents can bind macros to document events, such as opening or closing the document. The macro security setting decides whether macros that come with a document may run. Macros bound to the events of a Base document were run without the macro security setting being applied, so opening or converting a crafted database document could run a macro and, through it, any command. In fixed versions macros bound to the events of a Base document follow the macro security setting, as macros in other documents do.
CVE-2026-84443.summary_ko: LibreOffice Base에서 조작된 데이터베이스 문서를 열거나 변환하면 매크로 보안 설정을 우회해 매크로와 임의 명령이 실행될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-84443.background_ko: Base 문서 이벤트에 연결된 매크로를 실행할 때 매크로 보안 설정을 적용하지 않았다.

CVE-2026-86046.description: termux-sync is an open source tool for backing up and restoring a Termux environment across devices. Prior to 1.2.4, termux-sync restore uses the parent directory of the untrusted manifest.json files.*.source value as an extraction destination, and extract_archive calls tarfile.extract on archive members without enforcing a destination boundary. A victim who restores a malicious or tampered backup from local, shared, GitHub, or Google Drive storage can have files written anywhere the Termux user can write, including shell startup files or executable scripts that can lead to code execution when later used. The restore path also accepts unsafe backup_name values for temporary paths, and archive members are not constrained to the intended destination. This issue is fixed in version 1.2.4.

CVE-2026-87932.description: LibreOffice Writer can save documents in DOCX format. A document can contain content controls whose values are bound to custom XML data, and that data is updated with the current values when the document is exported, including in a conversion run from the command line. Values taken from the document were not escaped where they were used, so a crafted document could write a file of its choosing anywhere the user can write when it was exported to DOCX. In fixed versions these values are written into the document directly, and the XSLT transformations LibreOffice runs can no longer write files or use the network.
CVE-2026-87932.summary_ko: LibreOffice Writer에서 조작된 문서를 DOCX로 내보내면 사용자가 쓰기 권한을 가진 임의의 위치에 파일이 기록될 수 있다. 명령줄을 통한 변환도 영향을 받는다.
CVE-2026-87932.background_ko: DOCX 내보내기 중 사용자 지정 XML 데이터를 갱신할 때 문서에서 가져온 값을 이스케이프하지 않고 사용했다.

CVE-2026-88987.description: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, the HTML sanitiser does not remove script-capable XHTML and XML data URIs from stored CMS content. A CMS author can save such content, and JavaScript executes in the browser of another user who views it. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.

CVE-2026-88988.description: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, the HTML sanitiser does not remove SVG data URIs from stored CMS content even though SVG documents can execute script. A CMS author can save such content, and JavaScript executes in the browser of another user who views it. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.

CVE-2026-88989.description: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, a CMS user who can edit records through a GridField detail form can send a direct save request that creates a new record even when the user does not have permission to create that record type. The server-side save path checks edit access but does not enforce the required create permission before persistence. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.

CVE-2026-91110.description: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, the HTML sanitiser does not normalize certain control bytes that browsers ignore when parsing URLs. A CMS author can place those bytes before a javascript: URL in stored content so the sanitiser misses the dangerous scheme, and JavaScript executes in the browser of another user who views the content. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.

CVE-2026-91112.description: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, a user with CMS_ACCESS_SecurityAdmin but without ADMIN can edit or reparent a group that grants ADMIN-equivalent permissions through an assigned role or a parent group, thereby escalating to full administrative privileges. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.

CVE-2026-91113.description: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, a CMS user who can edit a record through a GridField detail form can submit a user-controlled ClassName value to change the record into an unrelated class without the create and edit permission checks required for that target class. This permits an unauthorized record type change outside the GridField's intended model hierarchy. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.

CVE-2026-91114.description: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, PermissionCheckboxSetField accepts permission codes that the field did not offer and stores them without an allowlist, then renders permission codes without escaping them. A user with access to the Security section can save attacker-controlled content as a permission code, causing JavaScript to execute in the browser of another user who views the field. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.

CVE-2026-91115.description: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. From 6.0.0 until 6.2.13, the writer option of i18nTextCollectorTask is passed to the dependency injector without validating that it names an allowed writer implementation. A crafted dev task URL can therefore instantiate arbitrary objects with attacker-controlled constructor arguments and execute code on the server. An administrator can be induced to run the task by following a link because the nested task did not require confirmation, and a site in dev mode exposes the path without authentication. CMS 5 is not affected. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.
CVE-2026-91115.summary_ko: Silverstripe Framework 6.0.0 이상 6.2.13 미만에서 임의 객체 생성으로 서버 코드 실행이 가능하다. 관리자의 작업 실행을 유도해 악용할 수 있으며, 개발 모드에서는 인증 없이 해당 경로에 접근할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-91115.background_ko: i18nTextCollectorTask의 writer 옵션이 허용된 구현인지 검증하지 않은 채 의존성 주입기에 전달되며, 하위 작업 실행에는 확인 절차가 없었다.

CVE-2026-97892.description: LibreOffice checks the digital signatures of a PDF document when the document is opened, and shows whether each signature is valid. An out-of-bounds write existed when a signature was checked, because the parts of the file that a crafted signature claims to cover were not checked against the size of the file. In fixed versions a signature that claims to cover anything outside the file is reported as not valid.

CVE-2026-97894.description: LibreOffice Calc can open spreadsheets in the DIF format, and text files such as CSV in the UTF-16 encoding. Both are read one line at a time. An out-of-bounds read existed when a line of a crafted file was read, because the length of the line could be miscalculated, so memory beyond the line could be copied into the imported document. In fixed versions each line is read up to its limit and no further.

CVE-2026-97999.description: LibreOffice Base documents can hold an embedded HSQLDB database. When the experimental features option is enabled, LibreOffice offers to migrate such a database to the embedded Firebird engine when the document is opened. A heap buffer overflow existed when binary values were copied during the migration, because a value could be longer than the space set aside for its column. In fixed versions that space is enlarged whenever a value is longer than its column.

CVE-2026-98100.description: LibreOffice can import documents in the HWP format, including pictures that link to an external file. An out-of-bounds read existed when the link target of a crafted picture was read, so memory past the picture data could end up in the converted document. In fixed versions the link target is taken only from the picture data.

CVE-2026-129295.description: mail-parser is a tool that parses emails by enhancing the Python standard library and extracting message details into a comprehensive object. From 4.2.0 until 4.6.1, attacker-controlled email headers can cause polynomial regular-expression backtracking during ordinary parse_from_string(), parse_from_bytes(), or parse_from_file() calls. In src/mailparser/utils.py, get_addresses() invokes the _ADDR_FALLBACK_RE fallback when strict address parsing yields no usable address, and overlapping quantifiers rescan padded address headers quadratically or cubically. In src/mailparser/const.py, parse_received() applies _CLAUSE_SPLITTER to uncollapsed whitespace in a Received header, causing quadratic backtracking when a whitespace run is not followed by a clause keyword. A small, well-formed message can keep mail gateway, ticketing, quarantine, or archival parsing workers busy for extended periods. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.1.
CVE-2026-129295.summary_ko: mail-parser는 일반 이메일 파싱 중 공격자가 제어한 헤더로 정규식 역추적이 과도하게 발생할 수 있다. 작은 정상 형식의 메시지로도 메일 게이트웨이 등의 파싱 작업자가 장시간 점유될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-129295.background_ko: 주소 파싱 대체 정규식의 겹치는 수량자와 Received 헤더에서 축약하지 않은 공백에 적용되는 절 분리 정규식이 과도한 역추적을 유발한다.

CVE-2026-129296.description: mail-parser is a tool that parses emails by enhancing the Python standard library and extracting message details into a comprehensive object. From 3.8.0 until 4.6.0, the write_attachments() and write_sample() APIs use attacker-controlled attachment filenames without sufficient sanitization and path containment validation. Directory traversal sequences and absolute filesystem paths can cause an attachment to be written outside the intended output directory. An attacker can overwrite files accessible to the parsing process when an application extracts attachments from a crafted message. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.0.

CVE-2026-129297.description: mail-parser is a tool that parses emails by enhancing the Python standard library and extracting message details into a comprehensive object. Prior to 4.6.2, get_server_ipaddress() can select an attacker-controlled address from attacker-controlled Received headers. The minimum mechanism needed to distinguish this spoofing issue, derived from the advisory's remediation analysis and verified fix evidence, is appearance-based candidate selection that can treat bracketed IPv4 or IPv6 addresses or HELO markers in sender-written text as MTA-recorded addresses and can continue past a trusted hop that names no address. Applications that rely on the returned value can attribute a message to an attacker-selected sender IP address. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.2.

CVE-2026-129299.description: mail-parser is a tool that parses emails by enhancing the Python standard library and extracting message details into a comprehensive object. Prior to 4.6.2, multiple message-processing behaviors can raise exceptions or silently lose content. Headers colliding with methods such as Parse, Message, and Write_Attachments can place bound method objects into parsed output and raise TypeError when a caller requests JSON serialization such as mail_json. When byte input is parsed through parse_from_bytes(), an 8-bit header value returned as email.header.Header can likewise raise TypeError when an X_raw accessor passes the value to json.dumps; both exceptions are outside the MailParserError hierarchy. Separately, rewritten names such as Subject_json and X_Spam_Flag can be substituted or disappear from mail, headers, and JSON output while has_defects remains false, and a headerless message can be treated as falsy before parser state is initialized, causing body and attachment properties to return empty values without an error signal. These behaviors can abort message processing or hide malicious indicators from downstream scanners. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.2.

CVE-2026-129300.description: mail-parser is a tool that parses emails by enhancing the Python standard library and extracting message details into a comprehensive object. From 3.7.0 until 4.6.3, receiveds_format() in src/mailparser/utils.py catches only TypeError and ValueError while converting the trailing date of an attacker-controlled Received header. An out-of-range year can cause calendar.timegm() to raise OverflowError, and a sufficiently large timezone offset can cause datetime.fromtimestamp() to raise OSError. These exceptions are outside the MailParserError hierarchy, so one crafted header can abort the entire message parse through every parse_from_* entry point and may drop a queued batch. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.3.

CVE-2026-129301.description: mail-parser is a tool that parses emails by enhancing the Python standard library and extracting message details into a comprehensive object. From 4.6.0 until 4.6.3, write_attachments() calls _safe_attachment_filename() and write_sample() without isolating failures for individual attacker-controlled MIME parts. An RFC 2231 filename containing a NUL, a basename exceeding NAME_MAX, or an undecodable base64 payload can raise ValueError, OSError, or binascii.Error and abort the entire save loop. Later attachments remain unwritten; when a caller catches only MailParserError, the failure is not surfaced through the expected library-exception path. If a downstream scanner or sandbox reads only the extraction directory, a payload after the crafted part can be missed even though it remains in the delivered message, and the aborted batch also causes availability loss. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.3.

CVE-2026-129306.description: libspdm is a sample implementation that follows the DMTF SPDM specifications. Prior to 3.8.3 and 4.0.0-rc2, libspdm_x509_verify_cert_chain() in os_stub/cryptlib_openssl/pk/x509.c and os_stub/cryptlib_mbedtls/pk/x509.c validates certificate signatures one link at a time instead of validating the complete X.509 path. In deployments using a pinned root with a constrained multi-tier PKI, an attacker holding a valid issuer credential below a constrained CA can present a subordinate certificate that exceeds pathLenConstraint or nameConstraints and may be accepted for SPDM identity validation. Exploitation requires the application to use libspdm's backend validation without an additional certificate-chain validation mechanism, the pinned root cannot be substituted, and the deployment's measurement policy must allow identity impersonation alone to satisfy its acceptance requirements. The mbedTLS backend remains unable to enforce nameConstraints because upstream mbedTLS does not implement that check. The full-chain validation changes are released in versions 3.8.3 and 4.0.0-rc2.

CVE-2026-101327.description: A maliciously crafted DLL placed in a predictable, attacker-writable temporary directory used by the Autodesk Installer can lead to privilege escalation to NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM due to insufficient validation of loaded libraries. An attacker with local and low-privilege access could exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code as SYSTEM.
CVE-2026-101327.summary_ko: Autodesk Installer의 취약점으로 로컬 저권한 공격자가 NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM으로 권한을 상승시킬 수 있다. 이를 통해 SYSTEM 권한으로 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-101327.background_ko: 예측 가능하고 공격자가 쓸 수 있는 임시 디렉터리에서 불러오는 라이브러리를 충분히 검증하지 않는다.

CVE-2026-119346.description: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. From 15.0.0 until 15.5.29 and 16.4.5, Next.js applications that use NextResponse to set cookies on Edge runtime routes expose the internal x-middleware-set-cookie header in the public response. This affects App Router route handlers and Pages Router Edge API routes. The header duplicates each cookie value and its attributes, so JavaScript already running on the same origin can read values that the Set-Cookie header marks HttpOnly, including sensitive session tokens set on an affected response. This issue is fixed in versions 16.4.5 and 15.5.29.
CVE-2026-119346.summary_ko: Next.js에서 NextResponse로 쿠키를 설정하는 Edge 런타임 경로가 내부 헤더를 공개 응답에 노출한다. 같은 출처에서 이미 실행 중인 JavaScript가 HttpOnly로 설정된 세션 토큰 등의 쿠키 값을 읽을 수 있다.
CVE-2026-119346.background_ko: 쿠키 값과 속성을 복제하는 내부 x-middleware-set-cookie 헤더가 공개 응답에 포함된다.

CVE-2026-119347.description: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. From 15.0.0 until 15.5.29 and 16.4.5, the /_next/image optimizer in self-hosted Next.js deployments can process attacker-supplied SVG content even when dangerouslyAllowSVG is false, which is the default. The SVG reaches a parser that the application intended to keep disabled, increasing exposure to denial of service and vulnerabilities in SVG decoding. This issue is fixed in versions 16.4.5 and 15.5.29.

CVE-2026-119348.description: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. Prior to 15.5.29 and 16.4.5, self-hosted Next.js App Router route handlers and the fetch cache that return a fetched upstream response unchanged can emit a response whose declared framing does not match the body actually sent. When the application is behind an HTTP/1.1 reverse proxy that permits pipelined response queueing, a crafted upstream response can desynchronize responses between clients. The resulting desynchronization can inject a response into another client's queue or disclose another client's response. This issue is fixed in versions 16.4.5 and 15.5.29.
CVE-2026-119348.summary_ko: 자체 호스팅 Next.js의 App Router 라우트 핸들러와 fetch 캐시에서 응답 동기화가 어긋날 수 있다. HTTP/1.1 응답 파이프라이닝을 허용하는 역방향 프록시 환경에서는 다른 클라이언트의 응답 큐에 응답이 삽입되거나 응답이 노출될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-119348.background_ko: 가져온 업스트림 응답을 그대로 반환할 때 선언된 응답 프레이밍과 실제 전송 본문이 일치하지 않을 수 있다.

CVE-2026-119349.description: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. From 16.0.0 until 16.4.5, Next.js App Router applications that pass binary arguments, such as Uint8Array or Blob values, to functions using the 'use cache' directive can generate identical cache keys for distinct arguments. Requests with different binary arguments can therefore share a cached result, causing cross-user disclosure of cached data or allowing one request to poison results returned to another user. This issue is fixed in version 16.4.5.
CVE-2026-119349.summary_ko: Next.js App Router에서 use cache 함수에 서로 다른 바이너리 인수를 전달해도 같은 캐시 결과가 공유될 수 있다. 이로 인해 사용자 간 캐시 데이터가 노출되거나 다른 사용자에게 반환되는 결과가 오염될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-119349.background_ko: use cache 함수에 전달된 서로 다른 바이너리 인수에 대해 동일한 캐시 키가 생성될 수 있다.

CVE-2026-119350.description: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. From 16.4.0 until 16.4.5, self-hosted Next.js applications served with next start can allow an unauthenticated request to poison a shared fallback shell when cacheComponents is true and partialPrefetching is unset or false. The affected dynamic route must have a prerenderable param declared by generateStaticParams whose requested value was not generated at build time, at least two never-prerenderable params below it, a layout that reads the shallower param inside a Suspense boundary, and a blocking fallback shell. A request-supplied placeholder route param whose path segment equals the percent-encoded bracketed name of its own deeper route param is incorrectly treated as unresolved, while the shallower concrete value is rendered into the shared shell and its HTTP status is persisted. Depending on application behavior, subsequent routes sharing that shell can receive a persistent 404 or attacker-selected substituted param text. Client hydration corrects substituted text, and the issue does not enable markup or script injection or disclose data. This issue is fixed in version 16.4.5.

CVE-2026-119351.description: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. From 16.2.0 until 16.4.5, Next.js applications with Cache Components enabled can reuse an outer 'use cache' entry across root param values when a nested 'use cache' call reads a root param through next/root-params and returns a value containing pending promises. React Flight can deliver the ready portion to the outer function before the inner cache finishes publishing its root-param dependencies. The outer entry can then complete and be persisted under a key that omits the root param, causing the first written value to be served for other root param values and allowing the outer entry to ignore nested cache tag invalidation and lifetimes. The leaked value is not attacker controlled and depends on which invocation writes the entry first. This variant does not require an existing inner cache entry or a slow cache handler and is not covered by the fix for CVE-2026-103004. This issue is fixed in version 16.4.5.
CVE-2026-119351.summary_ko: Cache Components가 활성화된 Next.js에서 중첩된 use cache 호출로 인해 최초 저장된 값이 다른 루트 매개변수 요청에도 제공될 수 있다. 외부 캐시가 중첩 캐시의 태그 무효화와 수명을 무시할 수도 있다.
CVE-2026-119351.background_ko: React Flight가 내부 캐시의 루트 매개변수 의존성 게시 전에 준비된 값을 전달해, 외부 캐시가 해당 매개변수 없는 키로 저장될 수 있다.

CVE-2026-119790.description: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. From 16.3.0 until 16.4.5, Next.js applications using the same 'use cache' function directly during rendering and through unstable_cache() can disclose cached data across root params when that function reads a root param. During the first fill after a cold process start, cross-request deduplication allows a concurrent unstable_cache() request to join the direct call's in-flight fill and receive its result before the root param mismatch is rejected. unstable_cache() then persists that result under a key that omits root params, causing later requests for other root param values to receive the same entry until revalidation or eviction. Exploitation requires the unstable_cache() request to arrive while the first fill is in flight. Outside this race, nesting 'use cache' inside unstable_cache() raises an unsupported-operation error, and avoiding that nesting prevents the issue. This issue is fixed in version 16.4.5.
CVE-2026-119790.summary_ko: Next.js에서 루트 매개변수를 읽는 같은 use cache 함수를 렌더링 중 직접 호출하고 unstable_cache()에서도 사용하면 캐시 데이터가 다른 루트 매개변수 요청에 노출될 수 있다. 프로세스 시작 후 최초 캐시 채움 중 요청이 겹쳐야 발생한다.
CVE-2026-119790.background_ko: 요청 간 중복 제거가 루트 매개변수 불일치 거부 전에 진행 중인 결과를 공유하고, unstable_cache()가 이를 루트 매개변수 없는 키로 저장한다.

CVE-2026-127218.description: Axigen Mail Server 10.3.3.67 through 10.3.3.x, 10.4.42 through 10.4.x, 10.5.29 through 10.5.x, 10.6.x before 10.6.41, and 10.7.x before 10.7.3 contains an unauthenticated denial of service vulnerability caused by uncontrolled recursion when validating query parameter and cookie values with a recursive regular expression engine before authentication in the WebAdmin and WebMail services. CVE-2026-129307.description: eml_parser serves as a python module for parsing eml files and returning various information found in the e-mail as well as computed information. In 3.0.3 and earlier, eml_parser.routing.parserouting() in eml_parser/routing.py builds a regular expression with multiple greedy capture groups and appends the npdate date literal extracted from a normalized copy of an attacker-controlled Received header, then searches that expression against the original unnormalized line. A formatting difference can make the trailing literal impossible to match, causing exhaustive backtracking across the greedy groups at each start position. The unsliced Received-header path is invoked by decode_email, decode_email_bytes, and parse_email, so one small unauthenticated message can pin a parser worker and create sustained queue backlog. This issue is fixed in version 3.0.4.

CVE-2026-83816.description: CodeWhale is a DeepSeek and MiMo coding agent for the terminal. Prior to 0.9.0, the ExecShellTool::approval_requirement_for path used is_parallel_readonly_command to downgrade commands to automatic approval based on a flag-stripped command allowlist. The allowlist treated fd, rg, and git grep as read-only even when fd -x or fd --exec, rg --pre, or git grep --open-files-in-pager selected an external program. registered_tool_approval_required returned without displaying a prompt for that automatic classification, and the later command-safety check also treated the base utilities as safe. Attacker-controlled content that influenced an agent tool call could therefore cause arbitrary program execution on the developer host without the approval promised by the default interactive profile, resulting in unauthorized access, modification, or disruption. This issue is fixed in version 0.9.0.
CVE-2026-83816.summary_ko: 터미널 코딩 에이전트 CodeWhale 0.9.0 이전 버전에 도구 명령 승인 우회 취약점이 있다. 공격자 통제 콘텐츠가 도구 호출에 영향을 주면 개발자 호스트에서 승인 없이 임의 프로그램이 실행되어 무단 접근·변조·중단이 발생할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-83816.background_ko: 옵션을 제거한 허용 목록이 외부 프로그램 실행 명령을 읽기 전용으로 오분류해 승인 요청을 생략하며, 후속 안전 검사도 기본 명령을 안전하다고 판단한다.

CVE-2026-83817.description: CodeWhale is a DeepSeek and MiMo coding agent for the terminal. Prior to 0.9.0, DEFAULT_AUTOMATION_AUTO_APPROVE caused AutomationRecord::task_auto_approve to resolve an omitted setting to true, and the automation_create schema advertised the same insecure default. enqueue_run_task converted that omission into an explicit true value, bypassing the safer task-path fallback and selecting ApprovalMode::Bypass for each scheduled run. After a user approved creation of an apparently benign recurring automation, subsequent executions could silently authorize mutating tools without a human present, and an automation created with shell access could repeatedly execute commands. This issue is fixed in version 0.9.0.

CVE-2026-87027.description: In EDB Postgres Extended Server and EDB Postgres Advanced Server versions 15 through 18 with Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) enabled, the key used to encrypt temporary files was incompletely initialized. The code applied sizeof() to a pointer to the key buffer rather than to the buffer itself, so only 8 of the intended 32 bytes were filled from a secure random source and the remaining 24 bytes kept whatever was already in memory. This reduces the guaranteed randomness of the temporary-file key from 256 bits to 64 bits. Exploiting this requires local read access to the server's temporary-file directory, and those files normally exist only while the server is running; they persist only after a crash and are removed at the next server start. Permanent data files and WAL are not affected. The issue is fixed in EDB Postgres Extended Server 15.20, 16.16, 17.12 and 18.7 and EDB Postgres Advanced Server 15.20.0, 16.16.0, 17.12.0 and 18.7.0; the server must be restarted after upgrading.

6cebb09b0a2a9ddd2f4efb96.summary_ko: Rapid7은 Apache Axis의 비인증 원격 코드 실행 취약점 CVE-2026-90436을 악용한 Confluence Data Center 공격을 탐지했다고 밝혔다. N-able도 N-central에서 해당 취약점과 연관성이 높은 공격을 보고했으며, 두 제품 모두 특정 비기본 설정에서 영향을 받는다. Confluence는 9.2.28 등으로 업데이트하고, N-central은 Legacy API 비활성화 등 공급사 지침을 따라야 한다.
6cebb09b0a2a9ddd2f4efb96.background_ko: 두 제품의 일부 버전이 취약한 Apache Axis 라이브러리를 사용하며, Confluence의 원격 API나 N-central의 Legacy API가 활성화된 경우 취약점에 노출된다.

curation.reason_ko: CERT/CC가 APFS 경로 비교 차이로 여러 제품의 파일 보호를 우회하는 문제와 패치를 공개했다.
